explanation: Bagi logam reaktif yang kedudukannya lebih tinggi daripada karbon dalam siri (seperti K, Na, Ca, Mg, Al), ikatan kimianya sangat kuat. Maka, ia hanya boleh diekstrak melalui kaedah elektrolisis sebatian leburannya menggunakan arus elektrik yang tinggi.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Logam ferum (besi) dan stanum (timah) terletak di bawah karbon dalam siri kereaktifan. Apakah kaedah pengekstrakan industri yang paling ekonomik bagi kedua-dua logam ini?
question_english: Ferrum (iron) and stanum (tin) are located below carbon in the reactivity series. What is the most economical industrial extraction method for both metals?
option_a_malay: Elektrolisis leburan garam klorida
option_a_english: Electrolysis of molten chloride salts
option_b_malay: Penurunan oksida logam tersebut menggunakan karbon
option_b_english: Reduction of their metal oxides using carbon
option_c_malay: Pemanasan terus sulfida logam di dalam udara terbuka
option_c_english: Direct heating of metal sulfides in open air
option_d_malay: Menggunakan agen penurunan gas hidrogen tulen
option_d_english: Using hydrogen gas as a reducing agent
explanation: Bagi logam-logam yang kurang reaktif daripada karbon (seperti Zn, Fe, Sn, Pb), oksida logamnya boleh diturunkan secara ekonomik melalui pemanasan kuat bersama karbon (arang kok) di dalam relau industri (seperti relau bagas).

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah campuran bahan mentah utama yang dimasukkan melalui bahagian atas Relau Bagas (Blast Furnace) untuk pengekstrakan besi?
question_english: Which of the following is the mixture of primary raw materials fed through the top of the Blast Furnace for the extraction of iron?
option_a_malay: Bijih besi + Gas asli + Batu kapur
option_a_english: Iron ore + Natural gas + Limestone
option_b_malay: Bijih besi + Arang kok + Batu kapur
option_b_english: Iron ore + Coke + Limestone
option_c_malay: Bijih besi + Serbuk aluminium + Pasir silika
option_c_english: Iron ore + Aluminium powder + Silica sand
option_d_malay: Besi tuangan + Karbon dioksida + Batu kapur
option_d_english: Cast iron + Carbon dioxide + Limestone
explanation: Bahan mentah utama pengekstrakan besi ialah: Bijih besi (hematit/Fe2O3), Arang kok (karbon/C sebagai bahan api dan agen penurunan), dan Batu kapur (kalsium karbonat/CaCO3 untuk membuang bendasing pasir).

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Gas penurunan utama yang menurunkan ferum(III) oksida di dalam relau bagas ialah karbon monoksida. Bagaimanakah gas karbon monoksida ini dihasilkan di dalam relau?
question_english: The primary reducing gas that reduces iron(III) oxide in the blast furnace is carbon monoxide. How is this carbon monoxide gas produced in the furnace?
option_a_malay: Pembakaran terus gas asli dengan udara panas
option_a_english: Direct combustion of natural gas with hot air
option_b_malay: Tindak balas antara karbon dioksida dengan arang kok yang panas
option_b_english: Reaction between carbon dioxide and hot coke
option_c_malay: Penguraian terma kalsium karbonat pada suhu tinggi
option_c_english: Thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate at high temperatures
option_d_malay: Pengoksidaan sisa sanga kalsium silikat
option_d_english: Oxidation of calcium silicate slag residue
explanation:
Di dalam relau bagas, arang kok terbakar dahulu menghasilkan karbon dioksida. Karbon dioksida yang naik ke atas bertindak balas dengan arang kok panas yang selebihnya untuk menghasilkan gas karbon monoksida yang bertindak sebagai agen penurunan yang kuat:
Karbon dioksida + Karbon -> Karbon monoksida

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Apakah fungsi utama batu kapur (kalsium karbonat) dan bagaimanakah sanga (slag) terbentuk di dalam relau bagas?
question_english: What is the primary function of limestone (calcium carbonate) and how is slag formed in the blast furnace?
option_a_malay: Membakar besi; kalsium klorida bertindak balas dengan silika
option_a_english: Burning iron; calcium chloride reacts with silica
option_b_malay: Menyingkirkan bendasing silika (pasir); kalsium oksida bertindak balas dengan silikon dioksida membentuk kalsium silikat
option_b_english: sanga
option_c_malay: Membekalkan oksigen tambahan; kalsium oksida bertindak balas dengan besi oksida membentuk kalsium ferat
option_c_english: Supplying additional oxygen; calcium oxide reacts with iron oxide to form calcium ferrite
option_d_malay: Menurunkan suhu relau; kalsium karbonat bertindak balas dengan arang kok membentuk kalsium karbida
option_d_english: Lowering the slagging temperature; calcium carbonate reacts with coke to form calcium carbide
explanation:
Batu kapur terurai membentuk kalsium oksida (CaO) yang bersifat bes. Kalsium oksida bertindak balas dengan bendasing berasid seperti silika/pasir (SiO2) membentuk kalsium silikat (CaSiO3) yang dikenali sebagai sanga (slag).
Kalsium oksida + Silikon dioksida -> Kalsium silikat

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Di bahagian bawah relau bagas, leburan besi dan leburan sanga terkumpul di dalam takungan. Bagaimanakah kedua-dua cecair ini dipisahkan secara fizikal?
question_english: At the bottom of the blast furnace, molten iron and molten slag accumulate in the hearth. How are these two liquids physically separated?
option_a_malay: Leburan sanga dimalapkan menggunakan air sejuk
option_a_english: Molten slag is solidified using cold water
option_b_malay: Sanga yang kurang tumpat terapung di atas leburan besi yang lebih tumpat, lalu dikeluarkan melalui saluran keluar berasingan
option_b_english: Slag, being less dense, floats on top of the denser molten iron and is tapped out through separate outlets
option_c_malay: Kedua-duanya dikeluarkan bersama dan ditapis menggunakan penapis magnetik
option_c_english: Both are tapped together and filtered using a magnetic filter
option_d_malay: Leburan besi mengwap terlebih dahulu meninggalkan pepejal sanga di bawah
option_d_english: Molten iron evaporates first leaving solid slag below
explanation: Leburan sanga mempunyai ketumpatan yang lebih rendah berbanding leburan besi tulen. Oleh itu, sanga terapung membentuk lapisan di atas leburan besi, membolehkan kedua-dua cecair dialirkan keluar melalui liang paip pengeluaran yang berbeza secara berasingan.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan kesan buruk aktiviti perlombongan bijih logam yang tidak dirancang dengan baik terhadap alam sekitar?

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Antara mineral berikut, yang manakah merupakan suatu mineral unsur (elemental mineral) semula jadi dalam kerak Bumi?
question_english: Which of the following minerals is a natural elemental mineral in the Earth's crust?
option_a_malay: Bauksit
option_a_english: Bauxite
option_b_malay: Hematit
option_b_english: Hematite
option_c_malay: Perak
option_c_english: Silver
option_d_malay: Kasiterit
option_d_english: Cassiterite
explanation:
Mineral unsur wujud bebas semula jadi tanpa terikat secara kimia sebagai sebatian. Perak (Silver) dan Emas (Gold) adalah contoh mineral unsur dalam kerak Bumi. Bauksit, Hematit, dan Kasiterit merupakan mineral sebatian.
*Translation:* Elemental minerals exist freely in nature without being chemically bonded as compounds. Silver and Gold are examples of elemental minerals in the Earth's crust. Bauxite, Hematite, and Cassiterite are compound minerals.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah nama sistematik IUPAC bagi mineral kasiterit (cassiterite) yang merupakan bijih logam utama di Malaysia?
question_english: What is the systematic IUPAC name for the mineral cassiterite, which is a major metal ore in Malaysia?
option_a_malay: Ferum(III) oksida
option_a_english: Iron(III) oxide
option_b_malay: Stanum(IV) oksida
option_b_english: Tin(IV) oxide
option_c_malay: Aluminium oksida
option_c_english: Aluminium oxide
option_d_malay: Kalsium karbonat
option_d_english: Calcium carbonate
explanation:
Kasiterit ialah sebatian semula jadi bagi stanum dan oksigen. Nama sistematiknya ialah Stanum(IV) oksida (Tin(IV) oxide), yang digunakan untuk mengekstrak logam timah.
*Translation:* Cassiterite is a natural compound of tin and oxygen. Its systematic name is Tin(IV) oxide, which is used to extract tin metal.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Sebutkan sebatian-sebatian unsur yang membina mineral semula jadi galena.
question_english: State the constituent elements that build the natural mineral galena.
option_a_malay: Aluminium dan oksigen
option_a_english: Aluminium and oxygen
option_b_malay: Plumbum dan sulfur
option_b_english: Lead and sulfur
option_c_malay: Silikon dan oksigen
option_c_english: Silicon and oxygen
option_d_malay: Ferum dan sulfur
option_d_english: Iron and sulfur
explanation:
Galena mempunyai nama sistematik Plumbum(II) sulfida (Lead(II) sulfide). Oleh itu, unsur-unsur yang membina sebatian ini ialah plumbum dan sulfur.
*Translation:* Galena has the systematic name Lead(II) sulfide. Therefore, the elements that make up this compound are lead and sulfur.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam Aktiviti 4.1, kalsium karbonat ditambahkan dengan asid hidroklorik cair. Apakah pemerhatian bagi gas yang dibebaskan apabila dilalukan ke dalam air kapur?
question_english: In Activity 4.1, calcium carbonate is added to dilute hydrochloric acid. What is the observation for the released gas when passed through lime water?
option_a_malay: Air kapur kekal jernih
option_a_english: Lime water remains clear
option_b_malay: Air kapur bertukar menjadi warna merah
option_b_english: Lime water turns red
option_c_malay: Air kapur menjadi keruh
option_c_english: Lime water turns cloudy
option_d_malay: Mendakan kuning terbentuk
option_d_english: A yellow precipitate is formed
explanation:
Tindak balas antara kalsium karbonat (limestone) dengan asid hidroklorik membebaskan gas karbon dioksida. Gas karbon dioksida meruap lalu mengeruhkan air kapur apabila dialirkan ke dalamnya.
*Translation:* The reaction between calcium carbonate (limestone) and hydrochloric acid releases carbon dioxide gas. Carbon dioxide gas turns lime water cloudy when bubbled through it.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah baki pepejal (residue) yang tertinggal di dalam tabung didih selepas serbuk kalsium karbonat dipanaskan dengan kuat (penguraian terma)?
question_english: What is the solid residue left in the boiling tube after calcium carbonate powder is heated strongly (thermal decomposition)?
option_a_malay: Kalsium klorida
option_a_english: Calcium chloride
option_b_malay: Kalsium oksida
option_b_english: Calcium oxide
option_c_malay: Kalsium hidroksida
option_c_english: Calcium hydroxide
option_d_malay: Karbon
option_d_english: Carbon
explanation:
Apabila kalsium karbonat dipanaskan dengan kuat, ia mengalami penguraian terma untuk menghasilkan kalsium oksida (pepejal putih baki) dan membebaskan gas karbon dioksida.
*Translation:* When calcium carbonate is heated strongly, it undergoes thermal decomposition to produce calcium oxide (white solid residue) and release carbon dioxide gas.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Kalsium karbonat boleh wujud dalam pelbagai bentuk semula jadi di Bumi. Antara berikut, yang manakah BUKAN bentuk kalsium karbonat semula jadi?
question_english: Calcium carbonate can exist in various natural forms on Earth. Which of the following is NOT a natural form of calcium carbonate?
option_a_malay: Batu kapur dan marmar
option_a_english: Limestone and marble
option_b_malay: Terumbu karang dan cangkang haiwan laut
option_b_english: Coral reefs and marine shells
option_c_malay: Kalsit dan kapur
option_c_english: Calcite and chalk
option_d_malay: Kuarza dan silika sand
option_d_english: Quartz and silica sand
explanation:
Kuarza dan pasir silika terdiri daripada silikon dioksida (silicon dioxide), bukan kalsium karbonat. Batu kapur, marmar, kalsit, kapur, terumbu karang, dan cangkang haiwan laut semuanya merupakan bentuk semula jadi kalsium karbonat.
*Translation:* Quartz and silica sand consist of silicon dioxide, not calcium carbonate. Limestone, marble, calcite, chalk, coral reefs, and marine shells are all natural forms of calcium carbonate.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Mengapakah logam seperti magnesium bertindak balas dengan sangat cergas dan menyala dengan terang apabila dipanaskan dalam oksigen, manakala besi hanya berbara dengan malap?
question_english: Why does a metal like magnesium react very vigorously and burn with a bright flame when heated in oxygen, while iron only glows dimly?
option_a_malay: Magnesium mempunyai takat lebur yang lebih tinggi
option_a_english: Magnesium has a higher melting point
option_b_malay: Magnesium lebih reaktif terhadap oksigen berbanding besi
option_b_english: Magnesium is more reactive towards oxygen than iron
option_c_malay: Besi adalah sejenis mineral unsur bebas
option_c_english: Iron is a type of free elemental mineral
option_d_malay: Besi tidak boleh bergabung dengan oksigen
option_d_english: Iron cannot combine with oxygen
explanation:
Kecergasan tindak balas logam dengan oksigen bergantung kepada kedudukan logam tersebut dalam siri kereaktifan logam. Magnesium terletak lebih tinggi daripada besi, menjadikannya lebih reaktif dan bertindak balas dengan lebih cergas.
*Translation:* The vigor of the reaction of metals with oxygen depends on the position of the metal in the reactivity series of metals. Magnesium is located higher than iron, making it more reactive and causing it to react more vigorously.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam Aktiviti 4.3 untuk membina siri kereaktifan logam, bahan kimia yang manakah digunakan sebagai ejen pembekal oksigen semasa pemanasan serbuk logam?
question_english: In Activity 4.3 to construct the reactivity series of metals, which chemical is used as the oxygen-providing agent during the heating of metal powders?
option_a_malay: Kalium manganat(VII)
option_a_english: Potassium manganate(VII)
option_b_malay: Kalsium karbonat
option_b_english: Calcium carbonate
option_c_malay: Asid hidroklorik cair
option_c_english: Dilute hydrochloric acid
option_d_malay: Anhidrus kalsium klorida
option_d_english: Anhydrous calcium chloride
explanation:
Hablur kalium manganat(VII) dipanaskan di dalam tabung didih untuk membebaskan gas oksigen bagi bertindak balas dengan serbuk logam yang dipanaskan.
*Translation:* Crystals of potassium manganate(VII) are heated in the boiling tube to release oxygen gas to react with the heated metal powder.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah fungsi utama wul kaca (glass wool) yang diletakkan di dalam tabung didih semasa menjalankan eksperimen tindak balas logam dengan oksigen?
question_english: What is the primary function of the glass wool placed inside the boiling tube during the experiment of metal reactions with oxygen?
option_a_malay: Membakar logam dengan lebih cepat
option_a_english: To burn the metal faster
option_b_malay: Menyerap gas berasid yang berbahaya
option_b_english: To absorb acidic toxic gases
option_c_malay: Mengasingkan hablur kalium manganat(VII) daripada serbuk logam
option_c_english: To separate potassium manganate(VII) crystals from the metal powder
option_d_malay: Mengesan perubahan suhu akhir
option_d_english: To detect final temperature changes
explanation:
Wul kaca bertindak sebagai penyumbat longgar untuk mengasingkan hablur kalium manganat(VII) (ejen pembekal oksigen) di bahagian hujung tabung didih daripada serbuk logam di bahagian tengah, bagi mengelakkan bahan-bahan tersebut bercampur secara fizikal sebelum pemanasan.
*Translation:* Glass wool acts as a loose plug to separate potassium manganate(VII) crystals (the oxygen source) at the end of the boiling tube from the metal powder in the middle, preventing them from mixing physically before heating.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Logam plumbum dipanaskan dengan oksigen dalam Aktiviti 4.3. Apakah pemerhatian yang betul bagi tindak balas ini?
question_english: Lead metal is heated with oxygen in Activity 4.3. What is the correct observation for this reaction?
option_a_malay: Terbakar dengan nyalaan sangat terang
option_a_english: Burns with a very bright flame
option_b_malay: Membara dengan cergas
option_b_english: Glows vigorously
option_c_malay: Membara dengan perlahan dan malap
option_c_english: Glows slowly and dimly
option_d_malay: Tiada sebarang perubahan warna atau haba
option_d_english: No color or heat change at all
explanation:
Plumbum mempunyai kereaktifan yang sangat rendah terhadap oksigen berbanding magnesium, aluminium, dan zink. Ia hanya membara secara perlahan dan malap untuk menghasilkan plumbum(II) oksida (pepejal kuning semasa panas, putih semasa sejuk).
*Translation:* Lead has a very low reactivity towards oxygen compared to magnesium, aluminium, and zinc. It only glows slowly and dimly to produce lead(II) oxide (solid yellow when hot, white when cold).

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Siri kereaktifan logam disusun mengikut kecenderungan logam bertindak balas dengan oksigen. Susun logam-logam berikut mengikut tertib kereaktifan meningkat (increasing reactivity order).
question_english: The metal reactivity series is arranged according to the tendency of metals to react with oxygen. Arrange the following metals in increasing reactivity order.
option_a_malay: Mg -> Zn -> Fe -> Pb -> Al
option_a_english: Mg -> Zn -> Fe -> Pb -> Al
option_b_malay: Pb -> Fe -> Zn -> Al -> Mg
option_b_english: Lead -> Iron -> Zinc -> Aluminium -> Magnesium
option_c_malay: Mg -> Al -> Zn -> Fe -> Pb
option_c_english: Magnesium -> Aluminium -> Zinc -> Iron -> Lead
option_d_malay: Pb -> Zn -> Fe -> Al -> Mg
option_d_english: Pb -> Zn -> Fe -> Al -> Mg
explanation:
Mengikut siri kereaktifan logam, Pb (plumbum) adalah paling kurang reaktif antara pilihan tersebut, diikuti oleh Fe (besi), Zn (zink), Al (aluminium), dan Mg (magnesium) sebagai yang paling reaktif. Susunan tertib meningkat ialah Pb -> Fe -> Zn -> Al -> Mg.
*Translation:* According to the reactivity series of metals, Pb (lead) is the least reactive among the choices, followed by Fe (iron), Zn (zinc), Al (aluminium), and Mg (magnesium) as the most reactive. The increasing order is Pb -> Fe -> Zn -> Al -> Mg.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam eksperimen menentukan kedudukan karbon dalam siri kereaktifan (Aktiviti 4.4), campuran serbuk karbon dan zink oksida dipanaskan dengan kuat. Apakah pemerhatian dan inferensnya?
question_english: In the experiment to determine the position of carbon in the reactivity series (Activity 4.4), a mixture of carbon powder and zinc oxide is heated strongly. What is the observation and its inference?
option_a_malay: Campuran membara dengan terang; Karbon berjaya menurunkan zink oksida kepada zink
option_a_english: Combustion is vigorous and bright; Carbon successfully reduces zinc oxide to zinc
option_b_malay: Tiada tindak balas berlaku; Karbon tidak dapat menurunkan zink oksida
option_b_english: No reaction occurs; Carbon cannot reduce zinc oxide
option_c_malay: Campuran meletup dengan kuat; Karbon lebih reaktif daripada aluminium
option_c_english: Combustion is strong; Carbon is more reactive than aluminium
option_d_malay: Larutan bertukar menjadi warna biru; Kuprum dihasilkan
option_d_english: The solution turns blue; Copper is produced
explanation:
Karbon terletak di atas zink dalam siri kereaktifan logam. Oleh itu, karbon lebih reaktif daripada zink dan dapat menurunkan zink oksida kepada logam zink, menghasilkan bara yang terang semasa pemanasan.
*Translation:* Carbon is located above zinc in the metal reactivity series. Therefore, carbon is more reactive than zinc and can reduce zinc oxide to zinc metal, producing a bright glow during heating.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apabila serbuk karbon dipanaskan bersama aluminium oksida, tiada sebarang tindak balas atau bara yang dikesan. Apakah inferens daripada pemerhatian ini?
question_english: When carbon powder is heated with aluminium oxide, no reaction or glow is detected. What is the inference from this observation?
option_a_malay: Karbon lebih reaktif daripada aluminium
option_a_english: Carbon is more reactive than aluminium
option_b_malay: Aluminium lebih reaktif daripada karbon
option_b_english: Aluminium is more reactive than carbon
option_c_malay: Karbon dan aluminium mempunyai tahap kereaktifan yang sama
option_c_english: Carbon and aluminium have the same reactivity level
option_d_malay: Aluminium oksida ialah sejenis mineral unsur bebas
option_d_english: Aluminium oxide is a free elemental mineral
explanation:
Tiada tindak balas berlaku menunjukkan karbon gagal menyingkirkan oksigen daripada aluminium oksida. Hal ini bermakna aluminium adalah lebih reaktif daripada karbon, sekali gus meletakkan karbon di bawah aluminium dalam siri kereaktifan.
*Translation:* No reaction occurs, indicating that carbon fails to remove oxygen from aluminium oxide. This means aluminium is more reactive than carbon, placing carbon below aluminium in the reactivity series.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Berdasarkan keputusan Aktiviti 4.4 dan tafsiran saintifik, di manakah kedudukan karbon diletakkan dalam siri kereaktifan logam?
question_english: Based on the results of Activity 4.4 and scientific interpretation, where is carbon positioned in the metal reactivity series?
option_a_malay: Di antara kalium dan natrium
option_a_english: Between potassium and sodium
option_b_malay: Di antara aluminium dan zink
option_b_english: Between aluminium and zinc
option_c_malay: Di antara zink dan ferum
option_c_english: Between zinc and iron
option_d_malay: Di bawah plumbum
option_d_english: Below lead
explanation:
Karbon dapat menurunkan zink oksida, ferum oksida, dan plumbum oksida, tetapi gagal menurunkan aluminium oksida. Oleh itu, karbon lebih reaktif daripada zink tetapi kurang reaktif daripada aluminium, meletakkannya di antara aluminium dan zink.
*Translation:* Carbon can reduce zinc oxide, iron oxide, and lead oxide, but fails to reduce aluminium oxide. Therefore, carbon is more reactive than zinc but less reactive than aluminium, placing it between aluminium and zinc.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam eksperimen aliran gas hidrogen merentasi oksida logam (Rajah 4.6), gas hidrogen yang kering dilalukan ke atas ferum(III) oksida yang dipanaskan dengan kuat. Apakah pemerhatian yang berlaku?
question_english: In the experiment of hydrogen gas flow over metal oxides (Figure 4.6), dry hydrogen gas is passed over strongly heated iron(III) oxide. What is the observation?
option_a_malay: Tiada sebarang tindak balas atau perubahan warna
option_a_english: No reaction or color change occurs
option_b_malay: Pepejal perang menyala dengan terang dan bertukar menjadi kelabu berkilat
option_b_english: Brown solid burns brightly and turns into shiny grey
option_c_malay: Pepejal kuning bertukar menjadi putih
option_c_english: Yellow solid turns white
option_d_malay: Campuran berasap tebal dan meletup
option_d_english: The mixture smokes heavily and explodes
explanation:
Hidrogen adalah lebih reaktif daripada ferum. Hidrogen bertindak menurunkan ferum(III) oksida (perang) kepada logam besi (kelabu berkilat), membebaskan haba (membara dengan terang) dan menghasilkan wap air.
*Translation:* Hydrogen is more reactive than iron. Hydrogen reduces iron(III) oxide (brown) to iron metal (shiny grey), releasing heat (glowing brightly) and producing water vapor.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Antara pasangan logam dan oksida logam berikut, yang manakah TIDAK akan menghasilkan sebarang tindak balas apabila dipanaskan bersama?
question_english: Which of the following pairs of metal and metal oxide will NOT produce any reaction when heated together?
option_a_malay: Karbon + Plumbum(II) oksida
option_a_english: Carbon + Lead(II) oxide
option_b_malay: Hidrogen + Ferum(III) oksida
option_b_english: Hydrogen + Iron(III) oxide
option_c_malay: Karbon + Magnesium oksida
option_c_english: Carbon + Magnesium oxide
option_d_malay: Hidrogen + Kuprum(II) oksida
option_d_english: Hydrogen + Copper(II) oxide
explanation:
Magnesium terletak di atas karbon dalam siri kereaktifan logam (magnesium lebih reaktif). Oleh itu, karbon tidak boleh menurunkan magnesium oksida dan tiada tindak balas berlaku. Bagi pilihan lain, karbon/hidrogen adalah lebih reaktif daripada plumbum, besi, dan kuprum, maka tindak balas penurunan berlaku.
*Translation:* Magnesium is located above carbon in the reactivity series (magnesium is more reactive). Therefore, carbon cannot reduce magnesium oxide and no reaction occurs. For other choices, carbon/hydrogen is more reactive than lead, iron, and copper, so reduction reactions occur.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Di manakah kedudukan hidrogen diletakkan dalam siri kereaktifan logam berdasarkan keputusan kajian saintifik (Jadual 4.2)?
question_english: Where is hydrogen positioned in the metal reactivity series based on the results of scientific studies (Table 4.2)?
option_a_malay: Di antara aluminium dan zink
option_a_english: Between aluminium and zinc
option_b_malay: Di antara magnesium dan aluminium
option_b_english: Between magnesium and aluminium
option_c_malay: Di antara zink dan ferum
option_c_english: Between zinc and iron
option_d_malay: Di antara ferum dan plumbum
option_d_english: Between iron and lead
explanation:
Gas hidrogen dapat menurunkan oksida bagi besi, plumbum, dan kuprum, tetapi gagal menurunkan oksida bagi zink dan aluminium. Maka, hidrogen terletak di antara zink dan ferum.
*Translation:* Hydrogen gas can reduce oxides of iron, lead, and copper, but fails to reduce oxides of zinc and aluminium. Thus, hydrogen is positioned between zinc and iron.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Bagi logam-logam yang terletak di atas karbon dalam siri kereaktifan (seperti kalium, natrium, kalsium, magnesium, dan aluminium), apakah kaedah pengekstrakan yang paling sesuai digunakan?
question_english: For metals located above carbon in the reactivity series (such as potassium, sodium, calcium, magnesium, and aluminium), what is the most suitable extraction method?
option_a_malay: Penurunan oksida logam oleh karbon
option_a_english: Reduction of metal oxide by carbon
option_b_malay: Elektrolisis sebatian logam dalam keadaan lebur
option_b_english: Electrolysis of molten metal compounds
option_c_malay: Pemanasan terus sebatian logam dalam udara
option_c_english: Direct heating of metal compounds in air
option_d_malay: Pengekstrakan fizikal terus daripada kerak Bumi
option_d_english: Direct physical mining from the Earth's crust
explanation:
Logam yang sangat reaktif (di atas karbon) mengikat oksigen atau klorida dengan sangat kuat. Ikatan kimia ini tidak boleh dipecahkan oleh penurunan karbon, sebaliknya memerlukan tenaga elektrik yang tinggi melalui proses elektrolisis leburan untuk mengekstrak logam tersebut.
*Translation:* Very reactive metals (above carbon) bind oxygen or chloride very strongly. These chemical bonds cannot be broken by carbon reduction; instead, they require high electrical energy through the electrolysis of molten compounds to extract the metal.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Logam ferum (besi) dan timah diekstrak daripada bijihnya di kilang industri terutamanya melalui proses...
question_english: Iron and tin metals are extracted from their ores in industrial plants primarily through the process of...
option_a_malay: Elektrolisis leburan garam
option_a_english: Molten electrolysis
option_b_malay: Penurunan oksida logam oleh karbon dalam relau bagas
option_b_english: Reduction of metal oxide by carbon in a blast furnace
option_c_malay: Tindak balas asid hidroklorik dengan mineral
option_c_english: Reaction of hydrochloric acid with minerals
option_d_malay: Pemanasan terus tanpa karbon
option_d_english: Direct heating without carbon
explanation:
Besi dan timah terletak di bawah karbon dalam siri kereaktifan logam, menjadikan kaedah penurunan oksida logam oleh karbon (arang kok) di dalam relau bagas sebagai kaedah industri yang paling ekonomi dan cekap.
*Translation:* Iron and tin are located below carbon in the metal reactivity series, making the reduction of metal oxides by carbon (coke) in a blast furnace the most economical and efficient industrial method.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam Relau Bagas (Blast Furnace) untuk pengekstrakan besi, apakah bahan kimia utama yang dimasukkan dari bahagian atas relau selain daripada bijih besi (hematit)?
question_english: In a Blast Furnace for iron extraction, what are the primary chemical materials fed from the top of the furnace other than iron ore (hematite)?
option_a_malay: Arang batu sahaja
option_a_english: Coal only
option_b_malay: Arang kok dan batu kapur
option_b_english: Coke and limestone
option_c_malay: Kalsium klorida dan silika sand
option_c_english: Calcium chloride and silica sand
option_d_malay: Gas karbon monoksida
option_d_english: Carbon monoxide gas
explanation:
Pengekstrakan besi memerlukan bijih besi (hematit), arang kok (karbon) sebagai ejen penurunan dan bahan api, serta batu kapur (kalsium karbonat) untuk menyingkirkan bendasing berasid (seperti silika).
*Translation:* Iron extraction requires iron ore (hematite), coke (carbon) as the reducing agent and fuel, and limestone (calcium carbonate) to remove acidic impurities (such as silica).

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Semasa pembakaran arang kok di dalam relau bagas pada suhu yang tinggi, gas manakah yang dihasilkan dan bertindak sebagai ejen penurunan kuat utama untuk menurunkan bijih besi kepada leburan besi?
question_english: During the combustion of coke in a blast furnace at high temperatures, which gas is produced and acts as the primary strong reducing agent to reduce iron ore into molten iron?
option_a_malay: Karbon dioksida
option_a_english: Carbon dioxide
option_b_malay: Karbon monoksida
option_b_english: Carbon monoxide
option_c_malay: Gas nitrogen
option_c_english: Nitrogen gas
option_d_malay: Wap air
option_d_english: Water vapor
explanation:
Karbon dioksida bertindak balas dengan arang kok yang panas untuk menghasilkan gas karbon monoksida (CO). Karbon monoksida ialah ejen penurunan utama yang menyingkirkan oksigen daripada ferum(III) oksida untuk menghasilkan leburan besi tulen.
*Translation:* Carbon dioxide reacts with hot coke to produce carbon monoxide gas (CO). Carbon monoxide is the main reducing agent that removes oxygen from iron(III) oxide to produce pure molten iron.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Batu kapur (kalsium karbonat) terurai di dalam relau bagas untuk menghasilkan kalsium oksida. Apakah fungsi kalsium oksida dalam pembentukan sanga (slag)?
question_english: Limestone (calcium carbonate) decomposes in the blast furnace to produce calcium oxide. What is the function of calcium oxide in the formation of slag?
option_a_malay: Menurunkan suhu operasi relau bagas
option_a_english: To lower the operating temperature of the blast furnace
option_b_malay: Menurunkan ferum(III) oksida kepada besi
option_b_english: To reduce iron(III) oxide to iron
option_c_malay: Bertindak balas dengan bendasing pasir (silika) untuk membentuk kalsium silikat
option_c_english: To react with sand/silica impurities to form calcium silicate
option_d_malay: Menghalang gas karbon monoksida daripada terlepas
option_d_english: To prevent carbon monoxide gas from escaping
explanation:
Kalsium oksida (bes) bertindak balas dengan bendasing pasir silikon dioksida (asid) yang ada di dalam bijih besi untuk menghasilkan kalsium silikat, yang dikenali sebagai sanga (slag).
*Translation:* Calcium oxide (base) reacts with silica/silicon dioxide impurities (acid) present in the iron ore to produce calcium silicate, which is known as slag.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Sanga (slag) dan leburan besi terkumpul di bahagian bawah relau bagas dalam fasa cecair. Bagaimanakah kedua-dua cecair ini dipisahkan secara fizikal?
question_english: Slag and molten iron accumulate at the bottom of the blast furnace in liquid phase. How are these two liquids physically separated?
option_a_malay: Sanga kurang tumpat daripada leburan besi, maka ia terapung di atas besi dan dikeluarkan melalui salur keluar yang berbeza
option_a_english: If the molten steel does not fit properly, it will float on top of the iron and be discharged through a different outlet
option_b_malay: Leburan besi membeku lebih cepat berbanding sanga
option_b_english: Iron casting cools faster than steel
option_c_malay: Sanga ditarik menggunakan elektromagnet kuat
option_c_english: The steel is drawn using a strong electromagnet
option_d_malay: Kedua-dua cecair bercampur sebati dan membentuk aloi besi tuangan
option_d_english: The two liquids mix uniformly and form cast iron
explanation:
Sanga (kalsium silikat) mempunyai ketumpatan yang lebih rendah berbanding leburan besi. Oleh itu, sanga terapung di lapisan atas, memudahkan pengeluaran cecair besi dan cecair sanga dilakukan secara berasingan melalui paip keluar relau bagas masing-masing.
*Translation:* Slag (calcium silicate) has a lower density compared to molten iron. Therefore, slag floats on the top layer, allowing molten iron and molten slag to be tapped out separately through their respective outlets.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan kegunaan industri bagi sanga (slag) yang dikumpulkan daripada sisa relau bagas?
question_english: Which of the following is an industrial application of the slag collected from blast furnace waste?
option_a_malay: Bahan utama membuat badan kenderaan
option_a_english: Primary material for making vehicle bodies
option_b_malay: Pembuatan simen dan asas pembinaan jalan raya
option_b_english: Manufacturing cement and road construction base
option_c_malay: Ejen pembekal elektrik alternatif
option_c_english: Electrical power alternative source
option_d_malay: Penghasilan bateri litium-kobalt
option_d_english: Production of lithium-cobalt batteries
explanation:
Sanga (slag) disejukkan dan dihancurkan untuk digunakan semula dalam industri pembinaan, terutamanya bagi pembuatan simen dan sebagai bahan asas dalam turapan jalan raya.
*Translation:* Slag is cooled and crushed to be reused in the construction industry, particularly for manufacturing cement and as a base material in road pavement.

chapter_title: Bab 4: Kereaktifan Logam (Reactivity of Metals) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Aktiviti perlombongan bijih logam yang tidak dirancang dengan baik boleh menyebabkan pelbagai isu alam sekitar. Antara berikut, yang manakah kesan negatif perlombongan terhadap biosfera dan hidrosfera?
question_english: Unplanned metal mining activities can cause various environmental issues. Which of the following is a negative effect of mining on the biosphere and hydrosphere?
option_a_malay: Penggunaan tenaga elektrik yang menjimatkan
option_a_english: Efficient electricity usage
option_b_malay: Kemusnahan habitat hidupan hutan dan pencemaran air sungai akibat kelodak bijih
option_b_english: Habitat loss of forest animals and river water pollution due to tailing dams
option_c_malay: Peningkatan kadar fotosintesis tumbuhan di sekeliling
option_c_english: Increase in plant photosynthesis rates
option_d_malay: Penurunan aras asid tanah
option_d_english: Decrease in soil acidity levels
explanation:
Perlombongan menuntut penebangan hutan (kemusnahan habitat/biodiversiti) dan pencucian bijih logam menghasilkan kelodak tanah serta sisa kimia yang mencemari aliran air sungai terdekat, memusnahkan kehidupan akuatik (hidrosfera).
*Translation:* Mining requires deforestation (habitat and biodiversity destruction), and washing metal ores produces silt and chemical wastes that pollute nearby rivers, destroying aquatic life (hydrosphere).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Apakah definisi termokimia yang paling tepat?
question_english: What is the most accurate definition of thermochemistry?
option_a_malay: Kajian tentang kadar tindak balas kimia yang dipengaruhi oleh suhu persekitaran.
option_a_english: A study on the rate of chemical reactions influenced by environmental temperature.
option_b_malay: Kajian tentang perubahan haba semasa tindak balas kimia berlaku.
option_b_english: A study on the change in temperature during a chemical reaction occurs.
option_c_malay: Kajian tentang pemindahan elektron antara bahan tindak balas dalam sel elektrokimia.
option_c_english: A study on the electron transfer between reactant materials in electrochemical cells.
option_d_malay: Kajian tentang kekuatan asid dan alkali berdasarkan kepekatan ion hidrogen.
option_d_english: A study on the strength of acids and bases based on hydrogen ion concentration.
explanation:
Termokimia ditakrifkan secara khusus sebagai bidang sains yang mengkaji perubahan tenaga haba (sama ada dibebaskan atau diserap) yang mengiringi tindak balas kimia.
*Thermochemistry is specifically defined as the branch of science that studies the changes in heat energy (either released or absorbed) accompanying chemical reactions.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan sistem dalam kajian termokimia?
question_english: Which of the following constitutes the "system" in thermochemical studies?
option_a_malay: Kawasan di luar bekas yang menerima haba daripada tindak balas.
option_a_english: The region outside the container that receives heat from the reaction.
option_b_malay: Termometer, bikar, dan udara di sekeliling tindak balas.
option_b_english: The thermometer, beaker, and air surrounding the reaction.
option_c_malay: Campuran bahan kimia yang bertindak balas di dalam bekas.
option_c_english: The mixture of chemicals reacting inside the container.
option_d_malay: Polistirena yang digunakan untuk menyalut bekas eksperimen.
option_d_english: The polystyrene used to insulate the experimental container.
explanation:
Dalam termokimia, "sistem" (system) merujuk kepada campuran bahan tindak balas yang sedang mengalami perubahan kimia di dalam bekas, manakala "persekitaran" (surroundings) adalah semua benda di luar sistem seperti bikar, termometer, dan udara sekitar.
*In thermochemistry, the "system" refers to the mixture of reactants undergoing chemical change inside the vessel, while the "surroundings" include everything outside the system, such as the beaker, thermometer, and surrounding air.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Apabila natrium hidroksida pepejal (NaOH) dilarutkan dalam air, bacaan termometer meningkat. Apakah kesimpulan yang boleh dibuat tentang tindak balas ini?
question_english: When solid sodium hydroxide (NaOH) is dissolved in water, the thermometer reading increases. What conclusion can be drawn about this reaction?
option_a_malay: Ia adalah tindak balas endotermik kerana haba diserap daripada persekitaran.
option_a_english: It is an exothermic reaction because heat is released into the surroundings.
option_b_malay: Ia adalah tindak balas eksotermik kerana haba dibebaskan ke persekitaran.
option_b_english: It is an endothermic reaction because heat is absorbed from the surroundings.
option_c_malay: Tiada perubahan haba berlaku, dan kenaikan suhu disebabkan oleh gerakan mekanikal zarah.
option_c_english: There is no change in heat, and the increase in temperature is caused by the mechanical movement of particles.
option_d_malay: Tenaga haba ditukarkan sepenuhnya kepada tenaga keupayaan kimia dalam hasil tindak balas.
option_d_english: Heat energy is completely converted into chemical potential energy in the products.
explanation:
Kenaikan suhu pada termometer (sebahagian daripada persekitaran) menunjukkan bahawa haba telah dibebaskan dari sistem ke persekitaran. Ini merupakan ciri utama tindak balas eksotermik.
*An increase in temperature on the thermometer (part of the surroundings) indicates that heat has been released from the system to the surroundings, which is the key characteristic of an exothermic reaction.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Bagaimanakah tenaga kimia hasil tindak balas dibandingkan dengan tenaga kimia bahan tindak balas dalam tindak balas eksotermik?
question_english: How does the chemical energy of the products compare to that of the reactants in an exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Tenaga kimia hasil tindak balas adalah lebih tinggi daripada bahan tindak balas.
option_a_english: The chemical energy of the products is higher than that of the reactants.
option_b_malay: Tenaga kimia hasil tindak balas adalah sama dengan bahan tindak balas.
option_b_english: The chemical energy of the products is the same as that of the reactants.
option_c_malay: Tenaga kimia hasil tindak balas adalah lebih rendah daripada bahan tindak balas.
option_c_english: The chemical energy of the products is lower than that of the reactants.
option_d_malay: Tiada kaitan antara tenaga kimia dengan pembebasan haba dalam tindak balas eksotermik.
option_d_english: There is no correlation between chemical energy and heat release in exothermic reactions.
explanation:
Dalam tindak balas eksotermik, sistem membebaskan tenaga haba ke persekitaran kerana hasil tindak balas mengandungi tenaga kimia yang lebih rendah daripada bahan tindak balas asal. Lebihan tenaga kimia ini dibebaskan sebagai haba.
*In an exothermic reaction, the system releases heat energy to the surroundings because the products contain less chemical potential energy than the original reactants. The excess chemical energy is emitted as heat.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan tindak balas endotermik?
question_english: Which of the following is an endothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Peneutralan antara asid hidroklorik dengan natrium hidroksida.
option_a_english: Neutralization of hydrochloric acid with sodium hydroxide.
option_b_malay: Pelarutan garam amonium klorida (NH4Cl) di dalam air.
option_b_english: Dissolution of ammonium chloride (NH4Cl) in water.
option_c_malay: Pembakaran pita magnesium dalam balang gas berisi oksigen.
option_c_english: Combustion of magnesium ribbon in a gas container filled with oxygen.
option_d_malay: Respirasi sel dalam organisma hidup untuk menghasilkan tenaga.
option_d_english: Cell respiration in living organisms to produce energy.
explanation:
Pelarutan amonium klorida di dalam air menyerap haba dari persekitaran, menyebabkan suhu air dan bekas menurun. Oleh itu, ia dikategorikan sebagai tindak balas endotermik.
*Dissolving ammonium chloride in water absorbs heat from the surroundings, causing the temperature of the water and container to decrease. Hence, it is classified as an endothermic reaction.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay:
Rajah di atas menunjukkan profil pemindahan tenaga semasa tindak balas kimia.
[ Bahan tindak balas + Haba → Hasil tindak balas ]
Apakah jenis tindak balas ini dan apakah kesannya terhadap suhu persekitaran?
question_english:
The diagram above shows the energy transfer profile during a chemical reaction.
[ Reactants + Heat -> Products ]
What type of reaction is this and what is its effect on surrounding temperature?
option_a_malay: Eksotermik; Suhu persekitaran meningkat.
option_a_english: Exothermic; Ambient temperature increases.
option_b_malay: Eksotermik; Suhu persekitaran menurun.
option_b_english: Exothermic; Ambient temperature decreases.
option_c_malay: Endotermik; Suhu persekitaran meningkat.
option_c_english: Endothermic; Ambient temperature increases.
option_d_malay: Endotermik; Suhu persekitaran menurun.
option_d_english: Endothermic; Ambient temperature decreases.
explanation:
Tindak balas yang memerlukan input haba untuk mengubah bahan tindak balas kepada hasil tindak balas (Bahan Tindak Balas + Haba -> Hasil Tindak Balas) ialah tindak balas endotermik. Pengambilan haba dari luar menyebabkan suhu persekitaran menurun.
*A reaction that requires heat input to convert reactants to products (Reactants + Heat -> Products) is an endothermic reaction. Absorbing heat from outside causes the surrounding temperature to fall.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Apakah tujuan utama menggunakan cawan polistirena dalam eksperimen untuk menentukan tindak balas eksotermik dan endotermik?
question_english: What is the primary purpose of using a polystyrene cup in experiments to determine exothermic and endothermic reactions?
option_a_malay: Polistirena bertindak balas secara kimia dengan bahan untuk meningkatkan kepekaan eksperimen.
option_a_english: Polystyrene reacts chemically with the material to enhance the sensitivity of the experiment.
option_b_malay: Polistirena adalah penebat haba yang baik untuk mengurangkan kehilangan haba ke persekitaran luar.
option_b_english: Polystyrene is a good thermal insulator to reduce heat loss to the surrounding environment.
option_c_malay: Untuk membolehkan pemanasan langsung menggunakan penunu Bunsen dilakukan dengan selamat.
option_c_english: To allow direct heating using a Bunsen burner, it is done safely.
option_d_malay: Polistirena dapat mempercepatkan kadar resapan zarah pepejal di dalam larutan akues.
option_d_english: Polystyrene can accelerate the rate of dissolution of solid particles in an aqueous solution.
explanation:
Untuk mengukur perubahan suhu persekitaran secara tepat, pemindahan haba antara campuran tindak balas dengan persekitaran luar bekas mesti diminimumkan. Cawan polistirena bertindak sebagai insulator yang mengehadkan kehilangan atau penyerapan haba luar.
*To accurately measure surrounding temperature changes, heat transfer between the reaction mixture and the outer surroundings must be minimised. Polystyrene cups act as insulators that limit external heat loss or gain.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Definisi secara operasi bagi tindak balas eksotermik dalam suatu eksperimen ialah...
question_english: The operational definition of an exothermic reaction in an experiment is...
option_a_malay: Bacaan suhu pada termometer meningkat apabila bahan kimia dicampurkan.
option_a_english: The temperature reading on the thermometer increases when the chemical is added.
option_b_malay: Gas karbon dioksida terbebas dan mengeruhkan air kapur.
option_b_english: Carbon dioxide gas is released and reacts with lime water.
option_c_malay: Pepejal putih melarut sepenuhnya menghasilkan larutan tanpa warna.
option_c_english: The white solid dissolves completely to produce a colorless solution.
option_d_malay: Tenaga kimia dalam bahan diukur menggunakan kalorimeter bom.
option_d_english: The chemical energy in the substance is measured using a bomb calorimeter.
explanation:
Definisi secara operasi (operational definition) menerangkan apa yang dilakukan dan apa yang diperhatikan secara langsung. Dalam kes eksotermik, pemerhatian langsungnya ialah kenaikan bacaan suhu pada termometer.
*An operational definition describes what is done and what is directly observed. In the case of an exothermic reaction, the direct observation is the increase in the thermometer's temperature reading.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Mengapakah proses membakar roti atau kek dikelaskan sebagai tindak balas endotermik?
question_english: Why is the process of baking bread or cake classified as an endothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Kerana yis membebaskan gas karbon dioksida yang meningkatkan kelembapan udara sekeliling.
option_a_english: Because it releases carbon dioxide, which increases the surrounding air humidity.
option_b_malay: Kerana adunan menyerap tenaga haba daripada ketuhar untuk memasak dan mengembang.
option_b_english: Because the dough absorbs heat from the pot to cook and rise.
option_c_malay: Kerana tindak balas penguraian tepung membebaskan haba yang banyak ke dinding oven.
option_c_english: Because the decomposition of flour releases a lot of heat to the oven walls.
option_d_malay: Kerana suhu adunan meningkat dengan sendiri tanpa bantuan luar selepas yis aktif.
option_d_english: Because the mixture's temperature increases on its own without external assistance after the yeast becomes active.
explanation:
Semasa membakar kek atau roti, adunan mesti terus-menerus menyerap tenaga haba daripada persekitaran (ketuhar) untuk membolehkan tindak balas kimia memasak bahan-bahannya berlaku.
*During baking, the batter must continuously absorb heat energy from the surroundings (the oven) to enable the chemical baking reactions of its ingredients to occur.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara fenomena semula jadi berikut, yang manakah melibatkan tindak balas eksotermik?
question_english: Which of the following natural phenomena involves an exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Proses fotosintesis dalam daun hijau semasa waktu siang.
option_a_english: The process of photosynthesis in green leaves during the daytime.
option_b_malay: Penguraian batu kapur di gua akibat tindakan air hujan berasid.
option_b_english: The decomposition of limestone in caves due to the action of acidic rainwater.
option_c_malay: Proses respirasi sel yang membebaskan tenaga haba untuk memanaskan badan.
option_c_english: The cellular respiration process that releases energy as heat to warm the body.
option_d_malay: Pembentukan embun pada daun pada waktu pagi yang sejuk.
option_d_english: The formation of dew on leaves in the early cool morning.
explanation:
Respirasi sel ialah tindak balas pembakaran glukosa secara biokimia di dalam sel badan yang membebaskan tenaga haba dan ATP (eksotermik), manakala fotosintesis pula menyerap tenaga cahaya matahari (endotermik).
*Cellular respiration is the biochemical oxidation of glucose inside body cells that releases heat energy and ATP (exothermic), whereas photosynthesis absorbs solar light energy (endothermic).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Pek panas segera digunakan untuk melegakan kekejangan otot. Antara bahan kimia berikut, yang manakah lazim digunakan dalam penghasilan produk ini?
question_english: Instant hot packs are used to relieve muscle cramps. Which of the following chemicals is commonly used in designing this product?
option_a_malay: Ammonium nitrat (NH4NO3) kering.
option_a_english: Ammonium nitrate (NH4NO3) powder.
option_b_malay: Natrium hidrogen karbonat (NaHCO3).
option_b_english: Sodium hydrogen carbonate (NaHCO3).
option_c_malay: Kalsium klorida kontang (CaCl2).
option_c_english: Calcium chloride (CaCl2).
option_d_malay: Ammonium klorida (NH4Cl).
option_d_english: Ammonium chloride (NH4Cl).
explanation:
Kalsium klorida kontang (anhydrous calcium chloride) atau magnesium sulfat kontang melarut dalam air secara eksotermik yang sangat kuat, membebaskan haba yang mencukupi untuk melegakan kekejangan otot dengan meningkatkan aliran darah.
*Anhydrous calcium chloride or anhydrous magnesium sulfate dissolves in water in a highly exothermic manner, releasing sufficient heat to relieve muscle cramps by increasing blood circulation.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Bagaimanakah pek sejuk segera membantu mengurangkan bengkak pada luka dari segi fisiologi?
question_english: How does an instant cold pack function physiologically to reduce wound swelling?
option_a_malay: Haba dibebaskan untuk mencairkan gumpalan darah di kapilari darah.
option_a_english: Heat is released to melt blood clots in capillaries.
option_b_malay: Haba diserap daripada tisu badan, menyebabkan lumen kapilari darah mengecut untuk mengurangkan keradangan.
option_b_english: Heat is absorbed from the body tissues, causing the diameter of the blood capillaries to constrict to reduce inflammation.
option_c_malay: Bahan kimia meresap masuk merentasi kulit untuk membunuh bakteria di kawasan luka.
option_c_english: Chemicals penetrate the skin to kill bacteria in the wound area.
option_d_malay: Ia menaikkan suhu sel badan untuk mempercepatkan proses mitosis sel kulit baru.
option_d_english: It raises the body cell temperature to speed up the process of mitosis of new skin cells.
explanation:
Pek sejuk segera menyerap haba secara endotermik daripada tisu badan yang bengkak/cedera. Kesan sejuk ini mengecutkan lumen kapilari darah (*vasoconstriction*), mengurangkan pengaliran darah ke kawasan tersebut, sekali gus meredakan bengkak, keradangan, dan pendarahan.
*Instant cold packs absorb heat endothermically from swollen/injured body tissues. This cold effect constricts blood capillary lumens (vasoconstriction), reducing blood flow to the area, thereby mitigating swelling, inflammation, and bleeding.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Seorang murid mereka bentuk pek sejuk menggunakan dua beg plastik, iaitu beg kecil berisi air dan beg besar berisi garam ammonium nitrat. Apakah tindakan mekanikal yang diperlukan untuk mengaktifkan pek tersebut?
question_english: A student designs a DIY cold pack using two plastic bags (one small containing water, one large containing ammonium nitrate salt). What mechanical action is required to activate this pack?
option_a_malay: Memanaskan beg plastik luar menggunakan lilin sehingga garam melebur.
option_a_english: Melt the plastic bag outer layer using a candle until the salt melts.
option_b_malay: Menekan beg plastik luar dengan kuat untuk memecahkan beg plastik dalam bagi mencampurkan bahan.
option_b_english: Press the outer layer of the plastic bag firmly to break the inner bag and mix the ingredients.
option_c_malay: Menggoncang beg plastik sehingga garam mengalir keluar secara resapan gas.
option_c_english: Shake the plastic bag until the salt flows out due to gas permeation.
option_d_malay: Mencucuk beg plastik luar menggunakan jarum untuk membiarkan udara luar masuk.
option_d_english: Puncture the outer layer of the plastic bag with a needle to allow external air to enter.
explanation:
Untuk mengaktifkan pek DIY, beg plastik dalam yang nipis yang berisi air perlu dipecahkan dengan cara ditekan/diramas. Ini membolehkan air bercampur dan melarutkan amonium nitrat (tindak balas endotermik) dengan selamat tanpa kebocoran luar.
*To activate the DIY pack, the thin inner plastic bag containing water must be ruptured by pressing/squeezing it. This allows water to mix with and dissolve the ammonium nitrate (endothermic reaction) safely without leaking externally.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Tindak balas termit digunakan untuk mengimpal landasan kereta api yang retak. Apakah logam yang terhasil dalam keadaan lebur akibat tindak balas eksotermik yang sangat hebat ini?
question_english: The thermite reaction is used to weld broken railway tracks. What metal is produced in a molten state due to this extreme exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Aluminium
option_a_english: Aluminium
option_b_malay: Kuprum
option_b_english: Copper
option_c_malay: Ferum
option_c_english: Besi
option_d_malay: Magnesium
option_d_english: Magnesium
explanation:
Tindak balas termit melibatkan tindak balas antara ferum(III) oksida dengan serbuk aluminium:

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara pasangan bahan tindak balas berikut, yang manakah menunjukkan penurunan suhu paling ketara apabila dicampurkan dalam cawan polistirena?

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Dari sudut termokimia, mengapakah pemanasan global berkait rapat dengan penebangan hutan?
question_english: Why is global warming closely linked to deforestation from a thermochemical point of view?
option_a_malay: Kemusnahan pokok mengurangkan tindak balas eksotermik respirasi sel yang menyejukkan atmosfera.
option_a_english: Decay of vegetation reduces the exothermic cellular respiration response that cools the atmosphere.
option_b_malay: Fotosintesis ialah tindak balas endotermik yang menyerap haba solar; kurang pokok bermakna kurang haba solar dan gas CO2 diserap dari atmosfera.
option_b_english: Photosynthesis is an endothermic process that absorbs solar heat; fewer trees mean less solar heat and CO2 being absorbed from the atmosphere.
option_c_malay: Kemusnahan pokok meningkatkan kadar penyejatan air tanah secara eksotermik yang memanaskan awan.
option_c_english: Decay of vegetation increases the exothermic rate of soil cooling which warms the clouds.
option_d_malay: Pokok mati mengalami reputan secara endotermik yang membebaskan sulfur dioksida ke udara.
option_d_english: Dead trees undergo endothermic decomposition releasing sulfur dioxide into the air.
explanation:
Fotosintesis tumbuhan adalah proses endotermik yang menyerap tenaga haba cahaya matahari serta gas rumah hijau utama, karbon dioksida ($CO_2$). Kemusnahan hutan mengurangkan kebolehan bumi menyerap haba dan gas $CO_2$ ini, menyebabkan peningkatan suhu atmosfera global.
*Plant photosynthesis is an endothermic process that absorbs solar heat energy and carbon dioxide ($CO_2$), a key greenhouse gas. Deforestation reduces Earth's capacity to absorb heat and $CO_2$, intensifying global temperatures.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Dalam suatu eksperimen termokimia, suhu awal air ialah 28 °C. Selepas ammonium klorida dilarutkan, suhu akhir menjadi tetap pada 21 °C. Berapakah perubahan suhu (Δθ) bagi eksperimen ini?
question_english: While conducting a thermochemistry experiment, a student found that the initial temperature of water was 28 °C. After dissolving ammonium chloride, the final temperature was stable at 21 °C. What is the temperature change (Δθ) for this experiment?
option_a_malay: $+7	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C}$
option_a_english: $+7\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$
option_b_malay: $-7	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C}$
option_b_english: $-7\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$
option_c_malay: $+49	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C}$
option_c_english: $+49\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$
option_d_malay: $-49	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C}$
option_d_english: $-49\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$
explanation:
Perubahan suhu dikira sebagai:
$$\Delta	heta = 	ext{Suhu Akhir} - 	ext{Suhu Awal} = 21	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C} - 28	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C} = -7	ext{ }^\circ	ext{C}$$
Tanda negatif ($-$) menunjukkan berlakunya penurunan suhu (penyerapan haba/endotermik).
*Temperature change is calculated as Final Temperature minus Initial Temperature, yielding -7 °C. The negative sign represents a drop in temperature, signifying an endothermic reaction.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara pernyataan berikut, yang manakah menerangkan keseimbangan terma yang dicapai pada akhir tindak balas eksotermik?
question_english: Which of the following statements describes the "thermal equilibrium" achieved at the end of an exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Suhu campuran tindak balas terus meningkat tanpa had secara eksponen.
option_a_english: The mixed reaction temperature continues to increase exponentially without limit.
option_b_malay: Suhu campuran menurun sehingga ia sama dengan suhu persekitaran luar.
option_b_english: The mixed temperature decreases until it is equal to the external ambient temperature.
option_c_malay: Semua tenaga kimia ditukarkan kepada tenaga mekanikal secara berterusan.
option_c_english: All chemical energy is continuously converted to mechanical energy.
option_d_malay: Suhu sifar mutlak ($0	ext{ K}$) dicapai di dalam cawan polistirena.
option_d_english: Absolute zero temperature ($0	ext{ K}$) is achieved within the polystyrene cup.
explanation:
Apabila tindak balas eksotermik selesai, pembebasan haba berhenti. Campuran yang panas akan memindahkan baki tenaga habanya secara beransur-ansur ke persekitaran luar sehingga ia mencapai suhu yang sama dengan suhu bilik sekeliling (keseimbangan terma).
*When an exothermic reaction finishes, heat release stops. The hot mixture gradually transfers its remaining heat energy to the external surroundings until it matches the room temperature (thermal equilibrium).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Nyatakan gas berasid yang dibebaskan daripada pembakaran bahan api fosil di stesen jana kuasa dan larut dalam air hujan lalu menghasilkan hujan asid.
question_english: State the acidic gas released from burning fossil fuels in power stations that dissolves in rainwater to produce acid rain.
option_a_malay: Karbon monoksida
option_a_english: Carbon monoxide
option_b_malay: Nitrogen gas
option_b_english: Nitrogen gas
option_c_malay: Sulfur dioksida
option_c_english: Sulfur dioxide
option_d_malay: Oksigen gas

explanation:
Pembakaran bahan api fosil (seperti arang batu) membebaskan gas sulfur dioksida ($SO_2$) yang berasid. Gas ini melarut dalam air hujan untuk membentuk asid sulfurik cair (hujan asid) yang merosakkan tisu tumbuhan dan menyuburkan keasidan tanah secara merosakkan.
*Burning fossil fuels (such as coal) releases acidic sulfur dioxide ($SO_2$) gas. This gas dissolves in rainwater to form dilute sulfuric acid (acid rain), destroying plant tissues and harmfully altering soil acidity.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Tindak balas antara asid kuat dengan alkali kuat dikenali sebagai tindak balas peneutralan. Apakah jenis tindak balas ini dan apakah molekul utama yang terbentuk?
question_english: The reaction between a strong acid and a strong alkali is known as a neutralisation reaction. What is the type of this reaction and the primary molecule formed?

option_b_malay: Endotermik; Garam natrium bikarbonat.

ightarrow H_2O$) adalah tindak balas eksotermik yang sentiasa membebaskan tenaga haba ke persekitaran semasa molekul air neutral terbentuk daripada gabungan ion asid dan alkali.

ightarrow H_2O$) is an exothermic reaction that always releases heat energy to surroundings as neutral water molecules form from acidic and alkaline ions.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Mengapakah pembakaran lilin dikelaskan sebagai tindak balas eksotermik?
question_english: Why is a burning candle classified as an exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Kerana lilin pepejal menyerap tenaga haba dari bilik untuk melebur menjadi cecair.
option_a_english: Because the solid candle absorbs heat energy from the room to melt into a liquid.
option_b_malay: Kerana pembakaran sumbu lilin membebaskan tenaga cahaya dan haba ke persekitaran.
option_b_english: Because the burning of the candle wick releases light and heat energy into the surroundings.
option_c_malay: Kerana lilin menghasilkan oksigen yang menyejukkan udara sekitar sumbu.
option_c_english: Because the candle produces oxygen that cools the air around the wick.
option_d_malay: Kerana suhu lilin menurun di bawah takat beku lilin lebur semasa menyala.
option_d_english: Because the candle's temperature drops below the melting point of the candle as it burns.
explanation:
Pembakaran lilin (combustion of hydrocarbons) ialah tindak balas pengoksidaan yang membebaskan tenaga tenaga haba dan cahaya (eksotermik) ke persekitaran sekelilingnya secara aktif. Kenaikan suhu dikesan di sekitar api lilin.
*Candle burning (combustion of hydrocarbons) is an oxidation reaction that actively releases heat and light energy (exothermic) to the surrounding surroundings, resulting in a temperature rise around the flame.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan definisi secara operasi bagi penyerapan haba dalam eksperimen sains?
question_english: Which of the following is the operational definition of heat absorption in a science experiment?
option_a_malay: Pembentukan gelembung gas di dalam bikar semasa tindak balas.
option_a_english: Formation of gas bubbles within the liquid during the reaction.
option_b_malay: Penurunan bacaan suhu pada termometer di dalam larutan.
option_b_english: Temperature reading on the thermometer decreases in the solution.
option_c_malay: Warna larutan litmus ungu bertukar menjadi biru gelap.
option_c_english: The color of the litmus solution turns deep blue.
option_d_malay: Berat bikar didapati bertambah selepas bahan dilarutkan.
option_d_english: The mass of the liquid is found to increase after the substance is dissolved.
explanation:
Definisi secara operasi bagi penyerapan haba (endotermik) ditunjukkan secara fizikal melalui kejatuhan/penurunan bacaan suhu pada termometer di dalam larutan tindak balas.
*The operational definition of heat absorption (endothermic) is physically shown through the drop/decrease in the temperature reading on the thermometer inside the reaction solution.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Pada waktu malam tanpa cahaya matahari, apakah proses utama yang dijalankan oleh tumbuhan hijau yang melibatkan perubahan tenaga haba?
question_english: Under night conditions without sunlight, what is the primary process carried out by green plants involving heat energy changes?
option_a_malay: Fotosintesis (Endotermik) yang menyerap haba dari persekitaran.
option_a_english: Photosynthesis (Endothermic) that absorbs heat from the environment.
option_b_malay: Transpirasi (Eksotermik) yang menghasilkan titisan embun pelembaban.
option_b_english: Transpiration (Exothermic) that produces dew-like moisture evaporation.
option_c_malay: Respirasi Sel (Eksotermik) yang membebaskan haba ke persekitaran.
option_c_english: Cell Respiration (Exothermic) that releases heat into the environment.
option_d_malay: Osmosis flasid sel pengawal yang menyerap haba dari tanah.
option_d_english: Osmosis in the guard cell that absorbs heat from the soil.
explanation:
Pada waktu malam, tumbuhan tidak menjalankan fotosintesis (endotermik) kerana tiada cahaya matahari. Namun, tumbuhan terus-menerus menjalankan respirasi sel (eksotermik) sepanjang masa untuk membebaskan tenaga kehidupan dan haba.
*At night, plants do not carry out photosynthesis (endothermic) due to the absence of sunlight. However, plants continuously perform cellular respiration (exothermic) all the time to release vital energy and heat.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Penguraian kalsium karbonat (CaCO₃) apabila dipanaskan dengan kuat di dalam makmal, seperti ditunjukkan dalam Rajah 1, menghasilkan kalsium oksida (CaO) dan karbon dioksida (CO₂). Tindak balas ini dikelaskan sebagai...
question_english: The decomposition of calcium carbonate ($CaCO_3$) when heated strongly in the laboratory (as shown in Figure 1) produces calcium oxide ($CaO$) and carbon dioxide ($CO_2$). This reaction is classified as...
option_a_malay: Eksotermik kerana ia membebaskan gas karbon dioksida.
option_a_english: Exothermic because it releases carbon dioxide gas.
option_b_malay: Endotermik kerana ia memerlukan bekalan tenaga haba berterusan dari penunu Bunsen untuk terurai.
option_b_english: Endothermic because it requires a continuous supply of heat from the Bunsen burner to decompose.
option_c_malay: Peneutralan asid-bes antara garam karbonat dengan air kapur.
option_c_english: Neutralization reaction between carbonate salt and lime water.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas pembakaran bergas yang menurunkan tekanan udara tabung uji.
option_d_english: Gas combustion reaction that lowers the test tube air pressure.
explanation:
Penguraian terma (thermal decomposition) bagi kalsium karbonat adalah tindak balas endotermik kerana bahan tindak balas mesti menyerap tenaga haba dari luar secara aktif untuk memutuskan ikatan kimia di dalamnya.
*The thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate is an endothermic reaction because the reactant must actively absorb heat energy from an external source to break its chemical bonds.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set A
question_malay: Apakah istilah bagi tindak balas kimia yang tidak membebaskan atau menyerap sebarang tenaga haba bersih daripada persekitarannya?
question_english: What is the term for a chemical reaction that does not release or absorb any net heat energy with its surroundings?
option_a_malay: Tindak balas Isoterma
option_a_english: Isothermal Response
option_b_malay: Tindak balas Endotermik
option_b_english: Endothermic Response
option_c_malay: Tindak balas Eksotermik
option_c_english: Exothermic Response
option_d_malay: Tindak balas Terma Seimbang
option_d_english: Thermally Balanced Response
explanation:
Tindak balas kimia atau fizikal yang berlaku tanpa sebarang perubahan bersih dalam tenaga haba atau suhu sistem dikenali sebagai proses atau tindak balas isoterma (isothermal).
*A chemical or physical reaction that occurs without any net change in heat energy or system temperature is known as an isothermal process or reaction.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah perbezaan utama antara sistem dengan persekitaran dalam eksperimen termokimia?
question_english: What is the main difference between the "system" and the "surroundings" in a thermochemical experiment?
option_a_malay: Sistem menyerap tenaga manakala persekitaran sentiasa membebaskan tenaga.
option_a_english: The system absorbs energy while the surroundings continuously release energy.
option_b_malay: Sistem terdiri daripada bahan tindak balas yang sedang mengalami perubahan kimia, manakala persekitaran adalah ruang dan bahan di luar campuran tindak balas tersebut.
option_b_english: The system consists of reactants undergoing chemical change, while the surroundings are the space and materials outside the reaction mixture.
option_c_malay: Sistem berada di luar bekas manakala persekitaran berada di dalam bekas tindak balas.
option_c_english: The system is outside the reaction vessel while the surroundings are inside the reaction vessel.
option_d_malay: Sistem hanya mengandungi air manakala persekitaran mengandungi termometer dan bikar sahaja.
option_d_english: The system contains only water while the surroundings contain a thermometer and bubbles only.
explanation:
Dalam sains termokimia, sistem merujuk kepada bahan tindak balas di dalam bekas di mana tindak balas kimia berlaku, manakala semua benda di luar sistem tersebut (termometer, air, bikar, udara) diisytiharkan sebagai persekitaran.
*In thermochemistry, the system refers to the reactants inside the container where the chemical reaction takes place, while everything outside that system (thermometer, water, beaker, air) is declared as the surroundings.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Rajah profil tenaga bagi suatu tindak balas menunjukkan bahawa tenaga hasil tindak balas lebih rendah daripada tenaga bahan tindak balas. Apakah jenis tindak balas tersebut?
question_english: An energy profile diagram of a reaction shows that the energy of the products is lower than the energy of the reactants. What type of reaction is this?
option_a_malay: Tindak balas endotermik kerana haba diserap daripada persekitaran.
option_a_english: Endothermic reaction due to heat absorption from the surroundings.
option_b_malay: Tindak balas eksotermik kerana haba dibebaskan ke persekitaran.
option_b_english: Exothermic reaction due to heat release to the surroundings.
option_c_malay: Tindak balas fotokimia kerana ia memerlukan tenaga cahaya.
option_c_english: Photochemical reaction as it requires light energy.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas peneutralan fizikal sahaja.
option_d_english: Physical neutralization reaction.
explanation:
Apabila tenaga kimia produk adalah lebih rendah daripada bahan tindak balas, ini bermakna lebihan tenaga kimia tersebut telah dibebaskan ke persekitaran dalam bentuk tenaga haba. Tindak balas ini dikenali sebagai eksotermik.
*When the chemical energy of the products is lower than that of the reactants, it means the excess chemical energy has been released to the surroundings as heat energy. This reaction is known as exothermic.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam tindak balas endotermik, mengapakah tenaga hasil tindak balas lebih tinggi daripada tenaga bahan tindak balas?
question_english: In an endothermic reaction, why is the energy of the products higher than the energy of the reactants?
option_a_malay: Kerana tenaga haba diserap dari persekitaran untuk ditukar kepada tenaga kimia di dalam produk.
option_a_english: Because heat energy is absorbed from the surroundings to be converted into chemical energy within the reactants.
option_b_malay: Kerana tindak balas memusnahkan semua atom bahan tindak balas.
option_b_english: Because the reaction breaks all atoms of the reactant.
option_c_malay: Kerana suhu persekitaran meningkat dengan mendadak semasa tindak balas.
option_c_english: Because the surrounding temperature rises suddenly during the reaction.
option_d_malay: Kerana pemutusan ikatan kimia membebaskan lebih banyak tenaga haba daripada pembentukan ikatan.
option_d_english: Because the breaking of chemical bonds releases more heat energy than the formation of bonds.
explanation:
Tindak balas endotermik menyerap haba dari persekitaran. Tenaga haba yang diserap ini disimpan sebagai tenaga kimia di dalam ikatan produk, menyebabkan produk mempunyai kandungan tenaga yang lebih tinggi daripada bahan tindak balas asal.
*Endothermic reactions absorb heat from the surroundings. This absorbed heat energy is stored as chemical energy in the bonds of the products, causing the products to have a higher energy content than the original reactants.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apabila garam ammonium nitrat (NH₄NO₃) dilarutkan dalam air, suhu menurun. Antara berikut, yang manakah benar tentang proses pelarutan ini?
question_english: When ammonium nitrate salt ($NH_4NO_3$) is dissolved in water, the temperature decreases. Which of the following is true about this dissolution?
option_a_malay: Ia adalah proses eksotermik kerana ia membebaskan tenaga haba.
option_a_english: It is an exothermic process because it releases heat energy.
option_b_malay: Ia adalah proses endotermik kerana ia menyerap tenaga haba dari persekitaran (air).
option_b_english: It is an endothermic process because it absorbs heat energy from the surroundings (water).
option_c_malay: Ia tidak melibatkan sebarang perubahan tenaga.
option_c_english: It does not involve any energy change.
option_d_malay: Ia menghasilkan gas karbon dioksida yang menyejukkan air.
option_d_english: It produces carbon dioxide gas that cools the water.

Kelebapan atau penurunan suhu pada bekas eksperimen membuktikan bahawa proses pelarutan garam ammonium nitrat menyerap haba daripada molekul air di sekelilingnya (persekitaran). Ini merupakan proses endotermik.
*A decrease in temperature on the experimental vessel proves that the dissolution of ammonium nitrate salt absorbs heat from the surrounding water molecules. This is an endothermic process.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Tindak balas antara asid sitrik dengan natrium hidrogen karbonat menyebabkan suhu campuran menurun. Antara berikut, yang manakah merupakan definisi secara operasi bagi tindak balas endotermik ini?
question_english: The reaction between citric acid and sodium hydrogen carbonate causes a decrease in the temperature of the mixture. Which of the following is the operational definition of this endothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Tindak balas yang membebaskan gas yang memadamkan kayu uji menyala.
option_a_english: The reaction that releases a extinguishing test wood burning gas.
option_b_malay: Penurunan bacaan suhu pada termometer apabila kedua-dua bahan itu bertindak balas.
option_b_english: The decrease in thermometer readings when the two substances react.
option_c_malay: Pembentukan larutan berwarna kuning pekat di dalam cawan polistirena.
option_c_english: Formation of a deep yellow colored solution in a polystyrene beaker.
option_d_malay: Kenaikan mendadak dalam nilai pH campuran tindak balas.
option_d_english: Sudden increase in the pH value of the reaction mixture.
