*An operational definition refers to what is physically observed and measured. Here, the physical effect of the endothermic reaction is studied through the decrease in the temperature reading on the thermometer.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Antara tindak balas berikut, yang manakah merupakan contoh tindak balas eksotermik?
question_english: Which of the following reactions is an example of an exothermic reaction?
option_a_malay: Pereputan terma kalsium karbonat ($CaCO_3$).
option_a_english: Thermal decomposition of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃).
option_b_malay: Tindak balas peneutralan asid hidroklorik dan natrium hidroksida.
option_b_english: Neutralization reaction between hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide.
option_c_malay: Fotosintesis oleh tumbuhan hijau pada waktu siang.
option_c_english: Photosynthesis by green plants during the day.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas antara asid etanoik dan natrium bikarbonat.
option_d_english: Reaction between ethanoic acid and sodium bicarbonate.
explanation:
Tindak balas peneutralan antara asid kuat dan alkali kuat sentiasa membebaskan haba ke persekitaran (suhu air meningkat), yang merupakan ciri universal bagi tindak balas eksotermik.
*Neutralisation reactions between a strong acid and a strong alkali always release heat to the surroundings (water temperature rises), which is a universal characteristic of exothermic reactions.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Pita magnesium dimasukkan ke dalam tabung uji yang mengandungi asid hidroklorik cair. Tabung uji terasa panas apabila disentuh. Mengapa?
question_english: A magnesium strip is placed in a test tube containing dilute hydrochloric acid. The test tube feels hot when touched. Why?
option_a_malay: Logam magnesium menyerap haba dari tangan secara konduksi aktif.
option_a_english: Magnesium metal actively absorbs heat from the hand by conduction.
option_b_malay: Tindak balas antara logam aktif dan asid adalah eksotermik dan membebaskan haba ke persekitaran.
option_b_english: The reaction between active metal and acid is exothermic and releases heat into the surroundings.
option_c_malay: Asid hidroklorik bertindak sebagai penebat yang memerangkap haba badan.
option_c_english: Hydrochloric acid acts as a catalyst that captures body heat.
option_d_malay: Berlaku proses penyerapan gas oksigen dari udara sekitar yang meningkatkan suhu tiub.
option_d_english: There is a process of oxygen gas absorption from the surrounding air which increases the tube's temperature.
explanation:
Tindak balas antara logam aktif (seperti magnesium) dan asid cair menghasilkan gas hidrogen dan membebaskan tenaga haba yang besar ke persekitaran, menyebabkan dinding tabung uji menjadi panas (eksotermik).
*The reaction between active metals (like magnesium) and dilute acids produces hydrogen gas and releases significant heat energy to the surroundings, making the walls of the test tube feel hot (exothermic).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah perubahan bentuk tenaga yang berlaku semasa pembakaran etanol secara eksotermik?
question_english: What is the change in the form of energy that occurs during the exothermic combustion of ethanol?
option_a_malay: Tenaga cahaya → Tenaga kimia
option_a_english: Light energy → Chemical energy
option_b_malay: Tenaga kimia → Tenaga haba + Tenaga cahaya
option_b_english: Chemical energy → Heat energy + Light energy
option_c_malay: Tenaga haba → Tenaga kimia
option_c_english: Heat energy → Chemical energy
option_d_malay: Tenaga elektrik → Tenaga kimia
option_d_english: Electrical energy → Chemical energy
explanation:
Semasa pembakaran etanol (bahan api fosil/organik), tenaga kimia yang disimpan dalam ikatan kimia etanol ditukarkan kepada tenaga haba dan tenaga cahaya yang dibebaskan secara aktif ke persekitaran.
*During the combustion of ethanol, chemical energy stored in the chemical bonds of ethanol is converted into heat energy and light energy released actively to the surroundings.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Semasa kalsium karbonat (CaCO₃) dipanaskan dengan kuat dalam Aktiviti 5.1, mengapakah pemanasan perlu dilakukan secara berterusan?
question_english: During the strong heating of calcium carbonate ($CaCO_3$) in Activity 5.1, why must the heating be performed continuously?
option_a_malay: Kerana tindak balas pereputan terma adalah eksotermik dan memerlukan pemangkin haba.
option_a_english: Because the termite reaction is exothermic and requires a heat source.
option_b_malay: Kerana kalsium karbonat mengalami tindak balas endotermik yang memerlukan penyerapan haba yang berterusan daripada penunu Bunsen untuk mereput.
option_b_english: Because calcium carbonate undergoes an endothermic reaction that requires continuous heat absorption from the Bunsen burner to decompose.
option_c_malay: Untuk mengelakkan gas karbon dioksida daripada meresap kembali ke dalam pepejal.
option_c_english: To prevent carbon dioxide gas from re-entering the solid.
option_d_malay: Kerana tindak balas tersebut menghasilkan gas oksigen yang mudah terbakar jika disejukkan.
option_d_english: Because the reaction produces flammable oxygen gas if cooled.
explanation:
Pereputan terma garam karbonat (seperti kalsium karbonat) ialah satu tindak balas endotermik tulen. Tindak balas ini memerlukan bekalan haba luaran yang berterusan untuk memutuskan ikatan kimia kalsium karbonat membentuk kalsium oksida ($CaO$) dan membebaskan gas karbon dioksida ($CO_2$).
*Thermal decomposition of carbonate salts (such as calcium carbonate) is a purely endothermic reaction. It requires a continuous external heat supply to break chemical bonds in calcium carbonate to form calcium oxide and release carbon dioxide gas.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Apakah gas yang dibebaskan apabila serbuk natrium hidrogen karbonat dilarutkan dalam asid hidroklorik cair dalam Aktiviti 5.1?
question_english: What gas is released when sodium hydrogen carbonate powder is dissolved in dilute hydrochloric acid in Activity 5.1?
option_a_malay: Gas Oksigen ($O_2$)
option_a_english: Oxygen Gas ($O_2$)
option_b_malay: Gas Nitrogen ($N_2$)
option_b_english: Nitrogen Gas ($N_2$)
option_c_malay: Gas karbon dioksida (CO₂)
option_c_english: Carbon dioxide gas (CO₂)
option_d_malay: Gas hidrogen (H₂)
option_d_english: Hydrogen gas (H₂)
explanation:
Tindak balas antara sebatian hidrogen karbonat (bikarbonat) dan asid cair sentiasa menghasilkan garam, air, dan membebaskan gas karbon dioksida. Pembebasan gas ini dikesan apabila gas dialirkan ke dalam air kapur dan menyebabkannya menjadi keruh (cloudy).
*The reaction between hydrogen carbonate (bicarbonate) compounds and dilute acids always produces salt, water, and releases carbon dioxide gas. This release is detected when the gas is bubbled into limewater and turns it cloudy.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Antara proses fisiologi berikut, yang manakah merupakan tindak balas eksotermik dalam organisma hidup?
question_english: Which of the following physiological processes is an exothermic reaction inside living organisms?
option_a_malay: Proses fotosintesis tumbuhan hijau.
option_a_english: The process of photosynthesis in green plants.
option_b_malay: Proses respirasi sel untuk menjana tenaga.
option_b_english: Cell respiration process to generate energy.
option_c_malay: Sintesis protein daripada asid amino.
option_c_english: Protein synthesis from amino acids.
option_d_malay: Pengangkutan aktif ion mineral merentasi membran.
option_d_english: Active transport of mineral ions across the membrane.
explanation:
Respirasi sel ialah satu proses pengoksidaan glukosa di dalam sel hidup yang membebaskan tenaga haba dan tenaga kimia (ATP) untuk kegunaan metabolisme badan, yang menjadikannya sejenis tindak balas eksotermik semula jadi.
*Cellular respiration is a process of glucose oxidation inside living cells that releases heat energy and chemical energy (ATP) for body metabolic use, making it a natural exothermic reaction.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Bagaimanakah proses fotosintesis dikelaskan dari sudut termokimia?
question_english: How is the photosynthesis process classified from a thermochemical standpoint?
option_a_malay: Tindak balas eksotermik kerana ia membebaskan gas oksigen ke atmosfera.
option_a_english: Exothermic reaction as it releases oxygen gas into the atmosphere.
option_b_malay: Tindak balas endotermik kerana ia menyerap tenaga cahaya dari Matahari untuk menukarkan karbon dioksida dan air kepada glukosa.
option_b_english: Endothermic reaction as it absorbs solar energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose.
option_c_malay: Tindak balas fizik sahaja tanpa melibatkan sebarang perubahan tenaga kimia.
option_c_english: Physical change without involving any chemical energy transformation.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas pemendapan pepejal kanji.
option_d_english: Precipitation reaction of kanji solids.
explanation:
Fotosintesis menyerap tenaga cahaya (sinaran matahari) secara aktif bagi menukar bahan mentah bertenaga rendah ($CO_2$ dan $H_2O$) menjadi molekul glukosa bertenaga tinggi. Ini merupakan proses penyerapan tenaga (endotermik).
*Photosynthesis actively absorbs light energy (solar radiation) to convert low-energy raw materials ($CO_2$ and $H_2O$) into high-energy glucose molecules. This is an energy absorption process (endothermic).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Tindak balas termit digunakan untuk mengimpal landasan kereta api. Apakah tindak balas termit dan mengapakah tindak balas ini dipilih untuk tujuan tersebut?
question_english: The Thermite Reaction is used in welding railway tracks. What is the thermite reaction and why is it selected for this task?
option_a_malay: Tindak balas endotermik antara karbon dan besi yang menyerap haba rel.
option_a_english: An endothermic reaction between carbon and iron that absorbs heat from the rail.
option_b_malay: Tindak balas eksotermik antara ferum(III) oksida dan serbuk aluminium yang menghasilkan haba melampau untuk meleburkan besi.
option_b_english: An exothermic reaction between iron(III) oxide and aluminium powder that produces enough heat to melt iron.
option_c_malay: Tindak balas pengoksidaan kuprum dengan gas oksigen tulen.
option_c_english: The oxidation of copper by pure oxygen gas.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas fizikal bermagnet antara kereta api dengan rel keluli.
option_d_english: A physical magnetic interaction between the train and the steel rail.
explanation:
Reaksi termit melibatkan tindak balas penurunan ferum(III) oksida oleh serbuk aluminium. Tindak balas ini adalah sangat eksotermik, membebaskan haba yang mencukupi untuk meleburkan ferum yang dihasilkan (molten iron) bagi menyambung rekahan landasan kereta api secara kekal.
*The thermite reaction involves the reduction of iron(III) oxide by aluminium powder. It is highly exothermic, releasing enough heat to produce molten iron used to weld railway track cracks permanently.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam pek panas segera, apakah bahan kimia kontang yang lazim digunakan dan bagaimanakah bahan itu diaktifkan?
question_english: In an instant hot pack, what anhydrous chemical is commonly used and how is it activated?
option_a_malay: Amonium nitrat kontang; diaktifkan dengan menggoncang beg udara.
option_a_english: Ammonium nitrate contang; activated by shaking the air bag.
option_b_malay: Natrium klorida kontang; diaktifkan dengan membakar sumbu luar.
option_b_english: Sodium chloride contang; activated by burning the outer fuse.
option_c_malay: Kalsium klorida kontang; diaktifkan dengan menekan pek untuk memecahkan pundi air dalaman supaya garam melarut secara eksotermik.
option_c_english: Calcium chloride contang; activated by pressing the button to break the inner water seal allowing the salt to dissolve exothermically.
option_d_malay: Kuprum(II) sulfat terhidrat; diaktifkan dengan mendedahkannya kepada cahaya matahari.
option_d_english: Hydrated copper(II) sulfate; activated by exposing it to sunlight.
explanation:
Pek panas segera mengandungi garam kontang seperti kalsium klorida kontang ($CaCl_2$) dan satu beg plastik air di dalamnya. Pengaktifan dilakukan dengan menekan pek untuk memecahkan beg air tersebut supaya garam melarut di dalam air secara eksotermik, membebaskan haba untuk melegakan kekejangan otot.
*Instant hot packs contain anhydrous salts like anhydrous calcium chloride ($CaCl_2$) and an inner plastic bag of water. Activation is done by squeezing the pack to break the water bag so the salt dissolves exothermically in water, releasing heat to soothe muscle cramps.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Pek sejuk segera yang digunakan di hospital untuk mengurangkan bengkak mengandungi bahan kimia penyerap haba. Apakah bahan tersebut?
question_english: An instant cold pack used in hospitals to reduce swelling contains a heat-absorbing chemical. What is this substance?
option_a_malay: Kalsium Klorida ($CaCl_2$)
option_a_english: Calcium Chloride ($CaCl_2$)
option_b_malay: Amonium Nitrat ($NH_4NO_3$)
option_b_english: Ammonium Nitrate ($NH_4NO_3$)
option_c_malay: Natrium Hidroksida ($NaOH$)
option_c_english: Sodium Hydroxide ($NaOH$)
option_d_malay: Magnesium Oksida ($MgO$)
option_d_english: Magnesium Oxide ($MgO$)
explanation:
Pek sejuk segera menggunakan pepejal amonium nitrat ($NH_4NO_3$) yang diasingkan daripada air. Apabila beg air dipecahkan, amonium nitrat melarut di dalam air secara endotermik, menyerap haba dari kawasan luka bengkak dan memberikan kesan penyejukan.
*Instant cold packs use solid ammonium nitrate ($NH_4NO_3$) isolated from water. When the water pouch is ruptured, ammonium nitrate dissolves in water endothermically, absorbing heat from the swollen wound and providing a cooling effect.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Mengapakah uncang air dalaman disertakan dalam reka bentuk pek panas segera dan pek sejuk segera?
question_english: Why is an inner water pouch included in the design of both instant hot and cold packs?
option_a_malay: Untuk bertindak sebagai pelincir luar bagi mengelakkan kebocoran beg.
option_a_english: To act as an external seal to prevent leakage of the bag.
option_b_malay: Untuk memastikan pepejal kimia kontang sentiasa kering sebelum digunakan, dan pengaktifan tindak balas termokimia hanya bermula apabila air bercampur dengan pepejal tersebut.
option_b_english: To ensure that the solid chemical catalyst remains dry before use, and the thermokimical reaction only starts when water mixes with the solid material.
option_c_malay: Untuk mengurangkan berat keseluruhan pek semasa disimpan.
option_c_english: To reduce the overall weight of the pek during storage.
option_d_malay: Untuk bertindak sebagai gas pengembang bagi pek udara.
option_d_english: To act as a foaming gas for air pek.
explanation:
Kedua-dua pek panas dan sejuk segera beroperasi berasaskan pelarutan garam kimia kontang di dalam air. Untuk mengelakkan pelarutan pramatang semasa penyimpanan, air diisikan di dalam pundi kecil yang berasingan dan hanya dipecahkan dengan tekanan fizikal apabila bersedia digunakan.
*Both instant hot and cold packs operate based on the dissolution of anhydrous chemical salts in water. To prevent premature dissolution during storage, water is sealed in a separate small pouch and is only ruptured with physical pressure when ready for use.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Proses membakar kek atau roti di dalam ketuhar ialah tindak balas endotermik. Antara berikut, yang manakah menerangkan sebab utama proses ini bersifat endotermik?
question_english: The process of baking cake or bread in an oven is an endothermic reaction. Which of the following explains the main reason why this process is endothermic?
option_a_malay: Bahan penaik menyerap haba dari ketuhar untuk mereput secara kimia dan membebaskan gas karbon dioksida yang mengembangkan kek.
option_a_english: The catalyst absorbs heat from the dough to undergo a chemical reaction and release carbon dioxide gas that causes expansion.
option_b_malay: Ketuhar membebaskan tenaga elektrik secara langsung ke dalam ikatan kimia gandum.
option_b_english: The dough releases electrical energy directly into the wheat molecule bonds.
option_c_malay: Suhu di dalam ketuhar berkurang dengan mendadak sebaik sahaja adunan dimasukkan.
option_c_english: The temperature inside the dough drops suddenly as soon as the mixture is added.
option_d_malay: Proses tersebut membebaskan tenaga kinetik daripada air tepung secara spontan.
option_d_english: This process releases kinetic energy from the flour water spontaneously.
explanation:
Semasa membakar kek/roti, bahan penaik (seperti natrium hidrogen karbonat) menyerap haba dari ketuhar (endotermik) untuk mengalami pereputan terma, membebaskan gas karbon dioksida ($CO_2$). Gas yang terperangkap ini mengembang dan menghasilkan rongga udara yang menaikkan adunan.
*When baking cake/bread, the baking powder (such as sodium hydrogen carbonate) absorbs heat from the oven (endothermic) to undergo thermal decomposition, releasing carbon dioxide gas. This trapped gas expands and creates air pockets that raise the batter.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Pembakaran bunga api berwarna-warni menghasilkan letupan yang sangat bertenaga. Apakah pengelasan termokimia bagi fenomena ini?
question_english: The combustion of colorful fireworks exhibits a highly energetic explosion. What is the thermochemical classification of this phenomenon?
option_a_malay: Endotermik kerana ia memerlukan haba permulaan daripada fius.
option_a_english: Endothermic as it requires an initial heat input from the fuse.
option_b_malay: Eksotermik kerana ia membebaskan sejumlah besar tenaga haba, cahaya, dan bunyi ke persekitaran secara spontan.
option_b_english: Exothermic as it releases a large amount of heat energy, light, and sound into the surroundings spontaneously.
option_c_malay: Fizikal sahaja kerana sulfur tidak bertukar menjadi sebatian baru.
option_c_english: Physical only as sulfur does not form a new compound.
option_d_malay: Endotermik kerana cahaya yang dihasilkan berwarna-warni mengikut penyerapan spektrum.
option_d_english: Endothermic as the generated light is multicolored following the absorption of the spectral range.
explanation:
Sebarang tindak balas pembakaran (seperti letupan bunga api) adalah sangat eksotermik. Sebaik sahaja dinyalakan, tindak balas kimia bahan letupan membebaskan tenaga yang sangat tinggi ke persekitaran dalam pelbagai bentuk tenaga berguna dan tidak berguna (haba, cahaya, bunyi).
*Any combustion reaction (such as a fireworks explosion) is highly exothermic. Once ignited, the chemical reaction of explosives releases very high energy to the surroundings in various forms of useful and non-useful energy (heat, light, sound).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Kempen penghutanan dijalankan secara aktif untuk membendung pemanasan global. Berdasarkan konsep termokimia, bagaimanakah penanaman pokok membantu mengurangkan haba atmosfera?
question_english: Afforestation campaigns are actively carried out to curb global warming. How does planting trees help reduce atmospheric heat based on thermochemical concepts?
option_a_malay: Daun pokok memantulkan semua radiasi haba kembali ke angkasa lepas.
option_a_english: Tree leaves reflect all heat radiation back into space.
option_b_malay: Fotosintesis pokok bertindak sebagai sinki endotermik gergasi yang menyerap gas karbon dioksida (gas rumah hijau) dan tenaga haba solar untuk membuat makanan.
option_b_english: Tree photosynthesis acts as an endothermic sink that absorbs carbon dioxide (greenhouse gas) and solar heat energy to produce food.
option_c_malay: Akar pokok meresap haba dari teras Bumi secara konduksi menegak.
option_c_english: Tree roots absorb heat from the Earth's surface by conduction vertically.
option_d_malay: Pokok bertindak membebaskan gas nitrogen sejuk yang menurunkan suhu atmosfera secara fizikal.
option_d_english: Trees release cool nitrogen gas which physically lowers atmospheric temperature.
explanation:
Peningkatan litupan hutan (afforestation) meningkatkan kadar fotosintesis global. Fotosintesis adalah tindak balas endotermik yang menyerap gas rumah hijau ($CO_2$) dan radiasi solar untuk menukarkannya kepada biomas kayu (tenaga kimia). Ini secara langsung mengurangkan kesan perangkap haba di dalam atmosfera Bumi.
*An increase in forest cover (afforestation) increases global photosynthesis. Photosynthesis is an endothermic reaction that absorbs greenhouse gas ($CO_2$) and solar radiation to convert them into wood biomass (chemical energy). This directly reduces heat-trapping effects in the Earth's atmosphere.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Tindak balas eksotermik menyumbang kepada pemanasan global melalui pembakaran bahan api fosil dalam sektor perindustrian. Mengapakah gas karbon dioksida (CO₂) daripada pembakaran ini berbahaya?
question_english: Exothermic reactions contribute to global warming through fossil fuel combustion in industrial sectors. Why is the carbon dioxide ($CO_2$) gas from this combustion harmful?
option_a_malay: Kerana ia merosakkan lapisan ozon secara langsung melalui tindak balas asid.
option_a_english: Because it directly damages the ozone layer through acidic reactions.
option_b_malay: Kerana ia bertindak sebagai gas rumah hijau yang menyerap dan memerangkap radiasi inframerah (haba) daripada dipancarkan kembali ke angkasa lepas.
option_b_english: Because it acts as a greenhouse gas that absorbs and traps infrared radiation (heat) from being radiated back into space.
option_c_malay: Kerana ia menurunkan kepekatan gas nitrogen dalam atmosfera secara mendadak.
option_c_english: Because it suddenly reduces the concentration of nitrogen gas in the atmosphere.
option_d_malay: Kerana ia memantulkan tenaga cahaya solar ke permukaan Bumi secara berlebihan.
option_d_english: Because it reflects solar energy back to the Earth's surface in excess.
explanation:
Gas $CO_2$ yang dibebaskan daripada tindak balas eksotermik pembakaran bahan api mempunyai keupayaan fizikal untuk menyerap radiasi terma inframerah yang dipantulkan dari permukaan Bumi. Tenaga haba ini terperangkap di dalam atmosfera, menyebabkan kenaikan suhu purata global (kesan rumah hijau).
*$CO_2$ gas released from exothermic fuel combustion reactions has the physical capability to absorb thermal infrared radiation reflected from the Earth's surface. This heat energy is trapped inside the atmosphere, causing a rise in global average temperature (greenhouse effect).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Pencairan ketulan ais di atas meja ialah contoh perubahan fizikal. Apakah pengelasan termokimia bagi proses ini dan mengapa?
question_english: The melting of an ice cube on a table is an example of physical change. What is the thermodynamic classification of this process and why?
option_a_malay: Eksotermik kerana ais membebaskan sejuk ke udara persekitaran.
option_a_english: Exothermic because ice releases heat to the surrounding air.
option_b_malay: Endotermik kerana ketul ais menyerap tenaga haba dari udara sekitar untuk memutuskan ikatan fizikal antara molekul air pepejal.
option_b_english: Endothermic because the formation of ice absorbs heat energy from the surrounding air to break the physical bonds between water molecules.
option_c_malay: Peneutralan kerana ais menukar pH air menjadi neutral.
option_c_english: Neutralization because ice changes the pH of water to neutral.
option_d_malay: Tindak balas kimia endotermik yang menghasilkan gas hidrogen.
option_d_english: Endothermic chemical reaction producing hydrogen gas.
explanation:
Melarut atau meleburnya ais adalah proses fizikal endotermik. Ais pepejal menyerap tenaga haba dari persekitaran (menyebabkan udara sekitar terasa sejuk) untuk mengatasi daya tarikan antara molekul air pepejal bagi bertukar menjadi air cecair.
*Melting of ice is an endothermic physical process. Solid ice absorbs heat energy from the surroundings (making the surrounding air feel cooler) to overcome attractive forces between solid water molecules to change into liquid water.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Natrium karbonat pepejal (Na₂CO₃) dan natrium hidrogen karbonat (NaHCO₃) dilarutkan secara berasingan dalam cawan polistirena berisi air. Bagaimanakah pemerhatian suhu bagi kedua-dua proses pelarutan ini dibandingkan?
question_english: Solid Sodium Carbonate ($Na_2CO_3$) and Sodium Hydrogen Carbonate ($NaHCO_3$) are dissolved separately in polystyrene cups filled with water. How do the temperature observations compare for these two dissolution processes?
option_a_malay: Kedua-duanya mencatatkan kenaikan bacaan termometer yang sama.
option_a_english: Both recorded the same thermometer reading increase.
option_b_malay: Pelarutan $Na_2CO_3$ mencatatkan penurunan suhu (endotermik) manakala pelarutan $NaHCO_3$ mencatatkan kenaikan suhu (eksotermik).
option_b_english: The dissolution of $Na_2CO_3$ recorded a decrease in temperature (endothermic) while the dissolution of $NaHCO_3$ recorded an increase in temperature (exothermic).
option_c_malay: Pelarutan $Na_2CO_3$ mencatatkan kenaikan suhu (eksotermik) manakala pelarutan $NaHCO_3$ mencatatkan penurunan suhu (endotermik).
option_c_english: The dissolution of $Na_2CO_3$ recorded an increase in temperature (exothermic) while the dissolution of $NaHCO_3$ recorded a decrease in temperature (endothermic).
option_d_malay: Kedua-duanya tidak menunjukkan sebarang perubahan suhu pada termometer.
option_d_english: Neither showed any temperature change on the thermometer.
explanation:
Mengikut keputusan eksperimen standard Sains Form 3 KSSM, pelarutan natrium karbonat kontang di dalam air membebaskan haba (bacaan suhu meningkat/eksotermik), manakala pelarutan natrium hidrogen karbonat menyerap haba dari air (bacaan suhu menurun/endotermik).
*According to standard KSSM Form 3 Science experimental results, the dissolution of anhydrous sodium carbonate in water releases heat (temperature reading increases/exothermic), while the dissolution of sodium hydrogen carbonate absorbs heat from water (temperature reading decreases/endothermic).

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Semasa menjalankan eksperimen termokimia menggunakan asid kuat dan alkali kuat di sekolah, mengapakah cawan polistirena digunakan sebagai bekas tindak balas dan bukannya bikar kaca biasa?
question_english: When conducting thermochemical experiments using strong acids and strong alkalis in school, why is a polystyrene cup used as the reaction vessel instead of a regular glass beaker?
option_a_malay: Polistirena boleh bertindak balas secara kimia dengan asid untuk meningkatkan suhu.
option_a_english: Polystyrene can react chemically with acids to increase temperature.
option_b_malay: Polistirena merupakan penebat haba yang baik yang meminimalkan kehilangan haba ke persekitaran, memastikan pengukuran perubahan suhu adalah lebih tepat.
option_b_english: Polystyrene is a good thermal insulator that minimizes heat loss to the surroundings, ensuring that temperature changes are more accurate.
option_c_malay: Polistirena adalah lut sinar dan memudahkan pemerhatian warna larutan.
option_c_english: Polystyrene is transparent and facilitates the observation of solution colors.
option_d_malay: Polistirena dapat menapis pembebasan gas hidrogen bertoksik daripada keluar.
option_d_english: Polystyrene can filter the release of toxic hydrogen gas to prevent it from escaping.
explanation:
Untuk mengukur kuantiti haba tindak balas dengan tepat, pemindahan haba antara campuran tindak balas (sistem) dan udara sekeliling (persekitaran) mestilah disekat. Polistirena digunakan kerana ia merupakan konduktor haba yang sangat lemah (penebat baik) yang mengurangkan kehilangan haba.
*To measure reaction heat accurately, heat transfer between the reaction mixture (system) and the surrounding air (surroundings) must be blocked. Polystyrene is used because it is a very poor heat conductor (good insulator) that reduces heat loss.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam bidang perubatan, jika pesakit mengalami kecederaan otot kronik atau bengkak lutut akibat aktiviti sukan, rawatan termokimia manakah yang paling sesuai sebagai pertolongan cemas?
question_english: In the medical field, if a patient suffers from chronic muscle injury or knee swelling due to sports, which thermochemical treatment is most suitable as first aid?
option_a_malay: Mengenakan pek sejuk segera untuk mengecilkan salur darah kapilari dan mengurangkan pendarahan serta bengkak di kawasan tersebut.
option_a_english: Apply a cold pack immediately to reduce capillary blood flow and minimize bleeding and swelling in the affected area.
option_b_malay: Mengenakan pek panas segera untuk meningkatkan pengaliran darah ke kawasan bengkak secara langsung.
option_b_english: Apply a hot pack immediately to increase blood flow to the swollen area directly.
option_c_malay: Menyapu asid kuat secara terus pada permukaan kulit bengkak.
option_c_english: Sweep strong acid continuously over the surface of the swollen skin.
option_d_malay: Membalut lutut menggunakan pemanas termit industri.
option_d_english: Wrap the knee with an industrial heater pad.
explanation:
Menurut Info Sains KSSM, pek sejuk segera digunakan untuk kecederaan bengkak akut dan pendarahan. Kesan penyejukan (endotermik) mengecutkan salur darah lumen bagi mengurangkan aliran darah ke tisu yang cedera, mengurangkan kesakitan, inflamasi, dan bengkak dengan berkesan. Pek panas segera digunakan kemudian untuk melegakan kekejangan otot yang tegang.
*According to KSSM Science Info, instant cold packs are used for acute swelling injuries and bleeding. The cooling effect (endothermic) constricts blood vessels to reduce blood flow to the injured tissue, effectively reducing pain, inflammation, and swelling. Instant hot packs are used later to relieve tight muscle spasms.

chapter_title: Bab 5: Termokimia (Thermochemistry) - Kuiz Set B
question_malay: Dalam amalan keselamatan makmal kimia, mengapakah asid pekat mesti dicairkan dengan menuangkan asid pekat secara perlahan-lahan ke dalam air sambil dikacau, dan bukannya menuangkan air ke dalam asid pekat?
question_english: In chemical lab safety practice, why must a concentrated acid be diluted by slowly pouring the concentrated acid into water (with stirring), rather than pouring water into the concentrated acid?
option_a_malay: Kerana tindak balas pelarutan asid di dalam air adalah sangat endotermik dan boleh membekukan air secara mengejut.
option_a_english: Because the acid dissolution reaction in water is highly endothermic and can freeze water unexpectedly.
option_b_malay: Kerana pelarutan asid pekat di dalam air adalah sangat eksotermik; menuang air ke asid boleh menyebabkan pembebasan haba yang sangat ekstrem pada titik sentuhan, menyebabkan air mendidih serta-merta dan memercikkan asid yang menghakis ke kulit.
option_b_english: Because the dissolution of concentrated acid in water is highly exothermic; pouring water into acid can cause a very extreme heat release at the point of contact, causing the water to boil instantly and splashing the corrosive acid onto the skin.
option_c_malay: Kerana air lebih berat daripada asid dan akan tenggelam ke dasar tanpa bertindak balas.
option_c_english: Because water is heavier than acid and will sink to the bottom without reacting.
option_d_malay: Untuk mengurangkan pembentukan mendakan sulfur kuning di dalam bekas.
option_d_english: To reduce the formation of yellow sulfur precipitation in the vessel.
explanation:
Proses pelarutan asid pekat di dalam air membebaskan kuantiti haba yang teramat besar (highly exothermic). Jika air dituang ke asid pekat, air yang sedikit di permukaan asid akan menyerap tenaga haba yang dilepaskan secara mendadak pada satu titik, lalu mendidih serta-merta dan memercikkan asid yang sangat mengakis ke luar. Melalui menuang asid perlahan-lahan ke dalam air yang banyak, air bertindak menyerap dan mengagihkan haba secara selamat tanpa pendidihan mendadak.
*The process of dissolving concentrated acid in water releases an immense amount of heat (highly exothermic). If water is poured into concentrated acid, the small amount of water on the acid surface will absorb the released heat energy suddenly at one point, boiling instantly and splashing highly corrosive acid outward. By pouring acid slowly into a large volume of water, the water absorbs and distributes the heat safely without flash boiling.
